reviews.author: Freya Wilson
reviews.snippet: I can't thank these good people enough. I flew over from the UK for business & wound up with severe dental pain. I was fortunate to get an emergency appointment & was utterly miserable, Richard put me at ease & instantly empathized with me, after some investigation & xrays, it was obvious I had a nasty infection & required urgent root canal. Both Richard & Lou opened their practice early the following morning to fit me in and take of me. They literally held my hand through the root canal process & they just couldn't have done more for me. After my treatment I felt good enough to head to the office & get on with my work trip. The following day they phoned to see how I was getting on and continued to give me after care advice. I am forever grateful that I stumbled upon their practice, having never had dental surgery before I couldn't have found a better practice to be looked after by. The wider team at the practice were also extremely kind & accommodating. Thank you for everything.

reviews.snippet: Beale and Cullen is honestly one of the best Dentists I have ever gone too. Being nervous as ever going to a dentist I first emailed to see what the procedures were going to be regarding my wisdom teeth getting removed. I then got a very swift response from a lovely lady named Joanne in which made me feel less anxious as she was very sweet and humble, she replied and said that I should come and get them checked out before the pain got worse and also pleasantly told me not be scared as she will make sure I will be okay. I then went down to my consultation and Joanne greeted me with a lovely smile, and shortly after I was introduced to a lady named Louisa, she straight away made me feel very comfortable as I let her know how nervous I was. Through the whole consultation she checked to see if I was okay which made my experience 100x better. Louisa then let me know that the best thing for me was to get these bad boys removed and then referred me to one of their best Oral surgeons in Christchurch that offer Sedation. Beale and Cullen should be so proud to have both of these ladies working there. They gave the best customer service I have received since moving to Christchurch and I will forever be going back there thanks to them!

It is my belief that Beale & Cullen is more than just a dental practice. It is a team of people that really do care. That value you as a person, not just as a customer.

reviews.snippet:
I was paranoid about going to the dentist. I took ages to make an appointment and would quite often not turn up or, if I did get as far as the waiting room would escape before it was my turn.

I started with Carl. I went to him for over 20 years; I lost my fear and did not hesitate to make my appointment and believe it or not I actually turned up and stayed there until seen. He was brilliant, reasonably priced, and thanks to him this old duck still has all her teeth.
Sadly, Carl has retired and has been replaced with the equally wonderful James....I went to see this young man for the first time today. No pain, so easy ...and he made me feel so relaxed. I was seen to on time and left thirty five minutes later fully confident that if I had to go again I would not hesitate to make my appointment, turn up and be totally satisfied with the result.... and it would not be a shock when I went to pay.
I highly recommend Cashmere Dentists......my teeth are still going strong!

reviews.author: Rob Winchester
reviews.snippet: Today I had another great experience with the great George! Always has a smile on his face and a warm welcome. I have been coming here for years and will continue to do so.

reviews.author: Gill Weavers
reviews.snippet: Absolutely fantastic service/treatment from Dr Carl McGregor today. I went there after a horrible experience elsewhere, and I’m very thankful for the whole experience. Professional, experienced, kind, considerate & caring. His assistant was fantastic and they both made the whole appointment enjoyable 😊 highly recommend Cashmere Dentists. Receptionist also really helpful & friendly.

reviews.author: Cahaya sarah
reviews.snippet: Ive been going to cashmere dentist aged 13-19 they are very caring and informative, but you have to book months in advance. George Glaussius was my dentist he gave me two fillings that were not filled down enough and later that caused gum pain and extra tension on my jaw. I will see Tash Glaussius as a dental hygienist in march (I called in the beginning of Jan). On their website they had the phone number of Prebbleton dentist and I highly recommend them for quicker dental advice and checkups.

reviews.author: Natacha Varlet
reviews.snippet: messed my teeth up as a child with my fillings made way too deep and now my teeth are close to being root canels at the age of 23... 1000% wouldnt recomend. All the dentists I have seen since have said my teeth must have been over drilled as a child. I had him up till 18 and I wish I never saw him. I have met 4 other people who he messed their teeth up so be careful.

reviews.author: Bobby clark
reviews.snippet: George and the team were absolutely brilliant  with my extractions. Infection didn't help but we kept on going. What a relief. Would definitely recommend friendly straight up and very competent. Thanks Chris

reviews.author: Georgia King
reviews.snippet: Had a great experience here- thank you James Nicholls for doing such a fantastic job. He is professional, skilled and put me at ease throughout the whole procedure.

reviews.author: Miranda Conner
reviews.snippet: Extremely rude receptionist who should not be allowed to use the phone's. You should at least know the name of the patient you are calling about lady. Might be time to retire.

reviews.author: Nicola Broad
reviews.snippet: Thoroughly recommend Tash (dental hygienist). So experienced and full of really useful tips and advice. Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Ben Blackmore
reviews.snippet: The only time I've been to the dentist and enjoyed the experience! The dentists were super friendly and strictly stated the facts, then took care of my teeth super efficiently! I'm super glad I chose this place!

reviews.author: Nicki Alexander
reviews.snippet: Excellent and speedy care for my son! Dr George was amazing! What a great experience! Recommend highly!

reviews.snippet: Had a positive experience when I went for my hygienist appointment with Abby. Great communication and made me feel at ease. Would highly recommend Abby & the team at Cathedral Dental 😊

Christchurch Boutique Dental.address: 105 Wainui Street, Riccarton, Christchurch 8041, New Zealand

reviews.author: Lara
reviews.snippet:
For someone who has always struggled with dental issues and has often been advised to get “needed” treatments, I’m genuinely so happy to have found Christchurch Boutique Dental!

Not only are they incredibly professional, but they’re also warm, genuine, and truly caring. From the dentists to the front‑of‑house staff, they make you feel comfortable the moment you arrive. What I appreciate most is how clearly they explain what’s causing the issues and walk me through the different options I can consider. They help me weigh my choices instead of pushing costly treatments without empathy, which has happened to me before elsewhere.

I’ve had most of my treatments done by Dr. Haneen, who is absolutely fantastic - gentle, thorough, and very reassuring. I’ve also been seen by Dr. David, who was equally great. And honestly, reading other reviews just confirms how consistently kind, professional, and highly skilled the whole team is.

I feel like I’ve found a dental practice I can truly trust.
I can’t recommend Christchurch Boutique Dental highly enough!

reviews.author: 徐瑟如
reviews.snippet: I did a lot of research and was contemplating to have my implants done in China but after having a consultation with Dr. David Kao, I cannot recommend him enough. He explained the importance of every step, he was so particular about little details especially my gums before placing the implants. He also explained the different brands of implants. I ended up having 2 implants done with David instead of flying back to China. It was the best decision ever! Thank you so much for the thoroughness and care.

reviews.author: Sagrika Kumar
reviews.snippet:
I highly recommend Christchurch Boutique Dental! Dr. Kah Ern Sha was incredibly gentle, professional, and thorough throughout my visit. She took the time to clearly explain everything, which made the entire experience feel comfortable and completely stress free. I truly appreciate her kindness and the outstanding level of care she provides.
A big thank you to Dr. Kah and her assistant Jess for exceptional care and dedication and the wonderful reception team, who were so friendly and welcoming from the moment I walked in.
Overall, it was such a positive experience, and I confidently recommend this clinic to anyone wanting dental care they can truly trust.

reviews.author: Chris Boyd
reviews.snippet:
This place is hands down, the best dentist practice I have visited in my life. Every experience (except the cost, which is similarly high to most other dentists in NZ) is impeccable.

As someone who has had traumatic dentistry in my past, it is of utmost importance to me that I feel comfortable and at ease in whatever practice I go to, and this place puts me at ease like no other. From the calm and relaxed manner of the people who take your booking over the phone, to the ambient / relaxing music played in the reception while waiting for your appointment. You can tell that so much care has been taken in these aspects as Boutique Dental understand how difficult it is for some of us to drag ourselves to the dentist.

My dentist in particular (Jeffery) is very impressive in his dentistry skills and is also a perfectionist. If something isn't quite right he will work at it until it is. His manner is very calm, relaxed and respectful. Unlike some dentists I have visited in the past, I actually look forward to my appointments with him as I really appreciate how much care he takes during our time together (and in any work that needs doing). I needed quite a lot of extensive work done when I first started going here and he did it all with aplomb. It's satisfying watching someone work at this level.

I've been going here for 2 or 3 (I can't quite remember) years now and will continue going for as long as I can. Thanks so much Boutique Dental, you have done wonders for my general attitude towards dentistry.

reviews.author: Mary Skiles
reviews.snippet: My best dental experience so far! I have so much anxiety when going to the dentist because of my past experiences, but I want to say that the Christchurch Boutique dental team is handling my concerns with so much care and empathy. I had a hygiene appointment with Genevieve and she has the gentlest hands!! I couldn’t believe I could have my teeth cleaned with almost zero pain. Just outstanding!!! Then I also had a dental consult with Dr. Kah Ern for my jaw pain and one thing that really stood out to me is how clear and informative  she is in explaining to me my condition and what the next steps are. This is such a refreshing and reassuring experience. I do believe there are plenty of dentists out there who are skilled at what they do, but the team at Christchurch Boutique can communicate eloquently on top of their dentistry skills. Highly recommend this clinic, shoutout to Genevieve and Dr. Kah Ern for the great service!

reviews.author: angela feldman
reviews.snippet: Had a great experience here getting a front tooth filling redone. I was so incredibly anxious about how it was getting it redone, but it was time. We had discussed veneers but in the end decided to be very conservative and simply just replace the filling. Dr. Kao did an INCREDIBLE job matching the adjacent tooth in color and shape. I couldn't be happier with the results.

reviews.author: Lincoln Hulbert
reviews.snippet: I spent weeks researching for the right dentist to bring my dream of having real fangs to life, I settled on Christchurch Boutique Dental and I've just been so happy and blown away by the care. Not only were the enthusiastic about my request from the beginning but they were so thorough for my consultation, my veneer appointment and booked me a follow up just to ensure I was happy with them and having no issues a week later. I adore my fangs so much, and for the first time I love my smile. Having a clinic who were almost as enthusiastic as I was really helped cement the idea I chose the right place. Everyone is so lovely, and it was just a wonderful experience

reviews.author: Maomao3322
reviews.snippet:
I had a wonderful experience at Christchurch Boutique Dental. The team is extremely professional and friendly, and they take the time to understand each patient’s needs. They explained everything clearly and offered great advice along with a well-structured treatment plan that suited me perfectly.

I truly appreciate their patience, care, and high level of service. Highly recommended!

5 star

reviews.author: Liz Turner

While I was initially nervous, I trust his opinion and went with it. From start to finish it took only a few hours! Happy to say I am delighted with the results.
Thanks team .. see you next time 😃

reviews.author: Ashleigh Clement
reviews.snippet:
I honestly can’t thank Dr Harrison enough. As someone who struggles with a fair bit of fear and anxiety around dental visits, I walked in feeling tense and apprehensive… but left feeling calm, cared for, and finally pain free! Harrison was incredibly patient and kind. He took the time to explain everything in a way that made me feel heard and comfortable, he never rushed anything and his calm and gentle manner helped ease my nerves almost instantly. The staff were just as lovely welcoming, warm, and reassuring from the moment I walked through the door. It genuinely made all the difference. What started as a visit I’d been dreading and had actually put off until I couldn't any longer; ended in me walking out not just without a toothache, but with a whole lot less fear too.

Thank you so much Colombo Team! I'll be back for any further dentist treatment without hesitation!

reviews.author: O K
reviews.snippet:
I appreciate you seeing me on such short notice despite me not being enrolled at your clinic.

Thank you for your understanding & patience while I was getting my first round of injections today.

An excellent dentist, a wonderful receptionist , and the nurse was very supportive.

Affordable pricing was also a plus!

reviews.author: Ruby Shaw
reviews.snippet: Recently moved to the Colombo Street dentist and Samuel and his team were absolutely great. They made the whole experience feel comfortable, calm, and pain-free. It was such a nice change that I had to leave a review!

reviews.author: Brooke wilson
reviews.snippet: I am petrified of the dentist. But this is the only practice I will go to. Dr Brady takes such good care of his patients and makes them feel as calm and safe as possible! Everyone here is super friendly and welcoming. I won’t go to any other practice again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: jillene Strang
reviews.snippet:
From the moment I walked into Colombo St Dental I knew my life would be changed forever.
Dr Sam Brady has returned my beautiful smile with the placement of crowns to restore damaged teeth using an on-site state-of-the-art milling machine that can create tooth crowns quick enough to have your new crowns ready and fitted in a day with colour match to the adjacent teeth perfectly.

I will be forever grateful.

reviews.author: Holly Waghorn
reviews.snippet: As someone with chronic illness, finding Sam has been a blessing. Sam is the most empathetic, gentle and knowledgeable dentist I have ever met. He's not afraid of my rare medical conditions like many health providers. I've never felt gaslighted, invalidated, or embarrassed, which is a rarity. I highly recommend Sam and his team for everyone, but especially those who have health challenges. Thank you to the team at Colombo Street Dental for taking such good care of me over the years.

reviews.author: Lachlan Mcleod
reviews.snippet:
I’ve been going to Sam for years and he’s by far the best dentist I’ve ever had. He’s gentle, explains everything clearly, and makes even the more stressful visits feel easy. You can tell he genuinely cares about his patients and their long-term dental health. The whole team is friendly and professional, which makes every visit a positive experience. Highly recommend!

Alex ☺️

reviews.author: John Shannon
reviews.snippet: I recently posted a review - which I've been humbled into deleting -  initially complaining about poor communication..but having persevered with ny initial misgivings & proceeding with suggested treatment  I've been left eating humble pie..BIGTIME ! Dr. Harrison's expertise was beyond exemplary..Within a 30 min. window he administered anaesthetic ; removed 12 teeth & ' patched ' his work with 12+ stitches .! ( Even allowed for 5 mins afterwards to check for excessive bleeding. )What's more. I only took 2 Tramadol ( for pain relief ) day of surgery , slept like a log & here we are..Day 2..& NO Tramadol reqd. ! The Man walks on WATER !

reviews.author: Cece Bartley
reviews.snippet: I've been with Dana Dental for 3 years - and she's fantastic :) Efficient, caring and a real problem solver. I've been given so much great daily advice for mouth care to ensure I only need a clean and polish once a yea. Her reception team is delightful to work with too :))

reviews.author: Iván Cárdenas
reviews.snippet: Dana was very professional and thoughtful. Thank you!

reviews.author: Margarita Kukleva
reviews.snippet: I just would like to share my experience with Dana dental. My doctor was Claudia and she did fantastic job, she made her best and improved my smile a lot, more than I expected. But Claudia did magic and saved my tooth. Thank so much, will go again for sure

reviews.author: Gimena Chavasco
reviews.snippet: I went couple of days ago and Claudia was fantastic!! Amazing doctor, very attentive and willing to help with everything. She was super professional and I didn't feel any pain at all despite it was a quite complicated treatment. Thank you Claudia!! I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Liam Duston
reviews.snippet: Experience was very comfortable, and straight forward. Love the dentists there, Dana is great. I would recommend to anyone :)

reviews.author: Jorja Baylee
reviews.snippet: All of the staff are so incredibly lovely! I went in this morning with a toothache, Sherin was great at explaining everything with great clarity. I had to get a filling, Sherin and her assistant were so great at checking in with me the entire time and making sure I was okay. Great after care instructions! I was super nervous before going to the dentist and left feeling completely at ease.

reviews.author: Noel Moone
reviews.snippet: As someone who has anxiety around dentistry I find Dental care on Barrington second to none. Their willingness to go the extra mile is wonderful and everyone from reception, hygienist, assistants and the dentists themselves are friendly, helpful and professional at all times. Thoroughly recommended.

reviews.author: Matt Holdem
reviews.snippet:
My experience left me feeling misled. What was communicated upfront did not match the outcome, and this significantly undermined my trust.

The owner was very pushy during discussions, and the interaction felt driven by money rather than fairness or professionalism. I would not deal with this business again.

reviews.author: Sarah Shaw
reviews.snippet:
Just a review on the customer service from the receptionist. Wow 👌 the nicest person I have ever spoken to to on phone..

Michelle Ling (Dentist) was horrible to see, left very upset and felt pushed out the door when I told her what treatment I preferred. Would not recommend booking in with her. I now go to Riccarton dental and the dental treatment I am receiving was recommended by them but they did not male me feel bad for expressing what I was wanting done. HIGHLY RECOMMEND RICCARTON DENTAL

reviews.author: Raquel Santos
reviews.snippet: It was the most gentle dental experience I've ever had! Sherin was incredibly professional and made me feel at ease throughout the entire process. She clearly explained everything before the procedure and also provided detailed post-extraction care instructions, which I really appreciated. The pricing was very reasonable too. Thank you so much! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: C M
reviews.snippet:
One of the worst dental practices. Many dentists seem motivated by greed, but this practice stands out as particularly egregious. The staff are rude, greedy, and unprofessional. They act as though any funds approved through Work and Income (WINZ) quotes belong to them. Driven by greed, they repeatedly increase charges, issuing quote after quote, which ultimately led to the loss of two of my teeth. When I informed them that I did not want to proceed with certain dental repairs, they became angry.

Several years ago, I visited a dentist regarding a tooth with a small black spot. I requested a minor filling to address it, as such spots are common and noticeable upon close inspection.

However, when I declined to have the small spot re-drilled and refilled at Dental Care on Barrington, the dentist became visibly angry.

reviews.author: Barry O 'Reilly
reviews.snippet: I usually choose a new place based on Google reviews. Had a filling fall out so needed to be seen relatively quickly and other top rated places didn't have availability and new enough to Christchurch so hadn't been to a Dentist here yet. Got really lucky with a cancellation at Dentalcare Barrington so they saw me the same day. Chris and the receptionist were very friendly and helpful. Chris was very easy to talk to and took the time to go through future options. I don't normally have a pleasant experience at a Dentist :P They deserve many more 5 stars reviews

reviews.author: Robert Woollands
reviews.snippet:
Dental Care on Barrington is a welcoming and caring practice. This starts with Odette (Practice Co-ordinator) at the front desk. Michelle (Dentist) did an amazing job in saving a tooth coupled with Mayu (Dental Assistant) who worked superbly with the dentist as a team.
I can strongly recommend this practice for its care, professional attitude and competitive rates.

reviews.author: Sarah Mclaren
reviews.snippet:
From the moment I arrived I was made to feel welcome and relaxed by the friendly staff and the roomy well furnished reception area.
Up to date magazines and the day's newspaper are on hand to read if you do have to sit a moment before you're appointment, this makes a change to the outdated magazines my GP has in his waiting room!
The dentist I saw explained everything in language I could understand and was VERY gentle.
Have to say best dental experience I've ever had, I will be back.

reviews.author: Eamonn Waters
reviews.snippet: I have been going to both the dentist (Chris) and hygienist (Lisa) for over five years and they are terrific.  Very good at explaining what's happening and creating a relaxed atmosphere. Receptionists are so friendly and welcoming.  Well priced.  I thoroughly recommend DentleCare on Barrington.

reviews.author: Lathish TM
reviews.snippet: Thank you, Dr. Sherin. I really loved your care and understanding. Your gentle approach and attention to detail made my visit comfortable and stress-free. The way you explained each step of the procedure and ensured I was at ease was truly appreciated. The staff was also friendly and professional, making the entire experience pleasant. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Adam Willington
reviews.snippet: A pleasant and professional experience. Chris performed what seemed to be a thorough examination and then spent time explaining the findings and his recommendations to me. I especially liked when he got me to hold a mirror so I could see exactly what he was talking about. I think their website needs some development and guidance prices on the website would be helpful especially as their charges are quite reasonable.  Overall perhaps the best dental experience I have had.

reviews.author: Lyne Cameron
reviews.snippet:
I am one of the original patients from when they opened 16 years ago. as I was in the market for a new dentist. so  just called in on my way home as they were refurbishing the practice  . What a good choice that was.
if one adheres to Chris's advice and has  regular check ups it is cost effective (took me a while to learn that!).  A very personable experience having treatment, and being able to get in for an emergency and not wait is such a blessing.
Good pricing and value for money. Chris always costs things out  so there  are  never any shocks at the end of the treatment.
Dental Care on Barrington do  value repeat business and looks after their customers.

Well worth a try if one is shopping for a good dentist.

Lyne Cameron

reviews.author: Karlotta Viktualia
reviews.snippet: By far the best dentist I've ever been to. I've never thought I could look forward to going to the dentist but everyone there is so lovely and the place itself feels more like a home than a clinic. Wonderful experience every time. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kim Harker
reviews.snippet:
All staff were very friendly and professional.
I felt comfortable and relaxed thought out the whole procedure.
The dental work was excellent and I would have no hesitation to recommend DentalCare on Barrington to anyone.

reviews.author: Tania Finn Angelo
reviews.snippet: Had to have a filling replaced. Sonya made it a painless and comfortable experience. The team are lovely, they put care into their work, their environment and are so professional. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: JIRI SLIVA
reviews.snippet: The best dental experience I have ever had in New Zealand. I have visited a few dentists in Christchurch and I'm use to high standard of dental care from Europe. Chris explained to me everything and answered all questions about my treatment. Price is more than reasonable.

reviews.author: Larissa Ou
reviews.snippet:
Brilliant service from the beginning. Friendly and helpful receptionist who explained about the prices and procedures before the appointment was booked. Very modern practice, sends an appointment confirmation txt which is very useful in this modern age and the practice itself was clean and slick- Good to see a dental practice that is keeping up with the times!

Wonderful staff, answered all questions and concerns I had and my teeth felt very well looked after, couldn't have asked for better dental care :)

Would highly recommend this practice for everyone

reviews.author: Dave Nicholls
reviews.snippet: I had cause to change my dentist recently and I researched a number before I settled on DentalCare on Barrington. I'm very pleased to say I made the right decision. I found Sonja very professional and thorough. Sonja is highly skilled and explained each step of the procedure well, I experienced no pain at all. Naoko supported Sonja and was wonderful, together a very slick team. The reception team is also amazing and followed up the next day to see if I was ok. It doesn't get any better than that, I'm actually looking forward to going back to my new dentist!

reviews.author: Ra R
reviews.snippet: Sonja is experienced, knowledgeable,  professional and very friendly. My choice for a Dentist. Tiffany the hygienist is easy to talk with is bubbly and provides very sound advise on oral care. 5 stars Team DentalCare on Barrington.

reviews.author: Rachael Hodge
reviews.snippet: I've always been very impressed with the service and friendly atmosphere. Would definitely recommend DentalCare on Barrington, their approachable and welcoming attitudes makes this dentist appropriate for all ages. It's very community focused and makes attending the dentist enjoyable. Keep up the good work!! :)

reviews.author: Kelly Corbett
reviews.snippet:
I have now become a regular patient at DentalCare on Barrington.

They have easy access and parking. Friendly reception staff and comfortable waiting area.

I have seen both Chris and Sonja and they are both very friendly and thorough. There is also a hygienist available.

reviews.author: Anne Barnett
reviews.snippet:
I have been going to Chris for years and can honestly say it is no drama visiting the dentist. Relaxing surroundings, very friendly, totally professional. Any procedures are discussed at length, with no nasty shocks re cost. An absolute 5 star rating.

Anne Barnett,
QSM.

reviews.author: Lanie Astley
reviews.snippet:
I would have to say i had an amazing experience with Chris Newbould and the team here. It started with the first phonecall to book the appointment and followed through to the first and subsequent consults!!!
Nothing has been difficult and it has felt like dealing with family re care, empathy and consideration.
Thank you so much !!!!!!
Ps the clinic just has a lovely feel the minute you walk thru the door - as i said family ☺

reviews.author: Robyn Robinson
reviews.snippet: Absolutely the most fantastically professional and caring dentist you could ever wish for.  Thank you Chris Newbold for making my smile sparkle through earthquakes!  Now I have moved north home to Whangarei... there's just one thing missing!  Perhaps I will have to return to quake city every 6 months because Chris's dentistry is so terrific he's worth leaving paradise.

Cant reccomend enough

reviews.author: Emily Abey-Nesbit
reviews.snippet: Wonderful dental centre. All of the staff are amazing and friendly. Sonja is probably the best dentist I've had. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Kylie Cowley
reviews.snippet: I've being going here for a few years now and am very happy with the service. All of the staff are friendly and professional. I've happily recommended them to friends and workmates. It's a great place to go if you're a nervous patient!

reviews.author: Kerry Potter
reviews.snippet: Very professional and efficient teamwork, with a gentle approach. Good for those who are nervous about having dental work done.

reviews.author: Blaithin O neill
reviews.snippet:
Incredible team! I have always been absolutely terrified of going to the dentist, but from the moment I walked in, the whole team did everything in their power to make me feel calm, safe, and completely at ease. I had quite a lot of procedures carried out, yet not once did I feel rushed, pressured, or like they were just trying to take my money. Every step was explained thoroughly, and the team took the time to answer the many stress-induced questions I had without ever making me feel silly or inconvenient.

A very special mention has to go to my dentist Swati Kaidan — she is truly incredible and such a huge credit to this business. Her professionalism and skill are outstanding; you can immediately tell she is extremely good at what she does. She worked with such confidence, precision, and care, which made me trust her completely. What really stood out, though, was her patience and kindness. Not just with me in the chair, but with my partner waiting, the assistants helping her and with the receptionists. She took the time to educate me about everything that was happening, explained things in a way that actually made sense, and constantly checked in to make sure I was comfortable.

Swati genuinely cares about her patients, and that comes across in everything she does. I left feeling not only relieved but actually grateful for the experience — something I never thought I’d say about a dental visit! I can’t recommend her and the entire team highly enough.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Garden Dental City! From the moment I walked in, the entire team made me feel welcomed, valued, and completely at ease.

Dr. Swati Kaidan was absolutely amazing. She was so patient, kind, and incredibly educational throughout the entire process. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I understood each step. What meant the most to me was that she truly moved at my pace. I never once felt rushed or pressured. She constantly checked in with me, made sure I was comfortable, and gave me full control — including taking breaks whenever I needed. I never felt like just another number in the chair.

Her assistants were just as wonderful — supportive, gentle, and attentive the whole time. You can really tell they care about their patients.

And the receptionists? Equally amazing! They were friendly, organized, and made the entire experience smooth from start to finish.

If you’re looking for a dental office where you feel heard, supported, and genuinely cared for, this is the place. I’m so grateful for the incredible experience I had here. Highly, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Pilli India
reviews.snippet:
My visit to Garden City Dentals came after a deeply distressing and disappointing journey elsewhere, and I feel compelled to share this experience because it restored my trust in dental care.
I developed a dental issue three months after my triple-bypass heart surgery, a time when any medical decision requires extreme care and sensitivity. I first visited another dentist, carefully handed over my complete medical file, underwent routine checks and three X-rays, and was advised to see a dental specialist. I was prescribed painkillers and billed accordingly. Though unsatisfied, I followed their recommendation.
The very next day, I visited the referred specialist clinic. Even before meeting the specialist, I was directed to undergo multiple X-rays and a 180-degree scan, resulting in a heavy bill. When I was finally called in, the specialist barely looked at me, did not review my medical records, and abruptly declared that nothing could be done because it was only three months after my heart surgery. I was sent out without discussion or explanation. I walked away feeling robbed, unheard, and deeply discouraged.
Seeking another opinion, I approached a different dentist. To my shock, they contacted the previous dentist without my consent to ask why I had not returned. At that point, I felt my privacy had been breached, and my confidence in the system was completely shaken.
That is when I walked into Garden City Dentals during afterhours—and everything changed.
From the very first interaction, the reception staff were cheerful, calm, and transparent, patiently explaining the process and putting me at ease. I was then seen by Dr Swati Kadian, whose approach was a complete contrast to what I had experienced before. She carefully examined me, reviewed my medical history, and only then suggested X-rays—clearly explaining why they were needed, the costs involved, the number of visits required, and the treatment options available, including the immediate denture method.
What stood out most was her professional diagnosis and prognosis—confident, thorough, and deeply reassuring. Given my recent heart surgery, I insisted on seeing a specialist, but Dr Kadian honestly and calmly declined, explaining that it was not necessary and that she was fully confident in managing my case safely. That clarity itself was comforting.
On the day of the extraction (three tooth from the upper jaw), her skill truly spoke for itself. The procedure was remarkably smooth and gentle. Her hands felt almost magical. At the slightest indication of discomfort, she immediately responded with additional anaesthesia, ensuring I felt no pain. Her approach was delicate, attentive, and compassionate throughout.
After months of anxiety, confusion, and disappointment, Garden City Dentals—and especially Dr Swati Kadian—gave me something invaluable: confidence, dignity, and relief. This was not just dental treatment; it was care delivered with integrity and humanity.
I am profoundly grateful and would wholeheartedly recommend Garden City Dentals to anyone, especially those with complex medical histories who need not just treatment but understanding and trust. Splendid work, keep it up, team!

reviews.author: Greice Silveira
reviews.snippet: I am sharing my experience today because, back in 2016/17, my English wasn’t good enough to explain the terrible experience I had with Claudia Uribe. I had a periodontal debridement done by her, which resulted in bleeding and swollen gums to the point that I couldn’t eat due to the pain. I went back to the clinic to ask her what had gone wrong, and she told me it was normal. However, she said she would prescribe me some medication to help. I waited for 20 to 25 minutes, only to realize that she was trying to find what to prescribe on Google. In the end, she didn’t suggest anything and just told me that the swelling and pain would go away within a couple of days. She then demanded payment, and when I protested, she took me to a corner and tried to intimidate me, telling me to pay or I would be in trouble. I was in shock after the way she spoke to me. I paid for my ‘consultation,’ but I have never forgotten that embarrassment. So be careful who you trust as your dentist. Until then, I had never had any issues with her, but from that day on, I could see what kind of professional she truly is. Sometimes you miss out on finding a good, reliable professional because of the price. It might be worth paying a bit more for a qualified professional.

After reading up on his successful background I was excited to give him a go and I was not disappointed. He made me look beautiful. On visiting a doctor many years back with a gum infection, he said “why have you come to see me, you should be going to your dentist” I said “But I don’t have any teeth” He looked at me aghast. Anyway, after 13 years I am back for a new set, I would never go anywhere else. Richard is gem and I can recommend him enormously.

reviews.author: Jim and Julie Hammersley
reviews.snippet: I had a missing tooth so went to see Richard. He crafted a new tooth that perfectly matched my real teeth. Nobody can tell it's not real. Now I can smile without feeling self conscious about my gap. It's a very comfortable fit. I thoroughly recommend his work. Richard's guaranteed to get you grinning again.

reviews.author: Allan Taylor
reviews.snippet: I engaged Richard to manufacture a full set of dentures as my old top denture had worn down to a point that when I smiled you couldn’t see them, I only had six of my original teeth at the bottom which were chipped and discoloured. I got to a point that I didn’t like conversing with people and when I did I tried not to smile, I was so embarrassed. and self conscious. After my consultation with Richard he put me at easy, I was ecstatic knowing that finally in the end I could converse with people and not be conscious of the way I looked. The whole process went very smoothly and I’m over the moon the way my dentures look so much so you can can not tell they are dentures. I wish I had known about Richard and Oral Design years ago. Highly recommend Richard, he’s the best in his field.

reviews.author: Pauline R
reviews.snippet:
After many years of ill fitting and uncomfortable dentures from various dentists and dental technicians I visited Richard. He discussed the options, his procedures and the costs with me.
Not only do I now have an amazing set of natural, functional teeth but Richard rebuilt my facial structure and my confidence. I cannot thank him enough and have no hesitation in recommending his artistry and care.

reviews.author: Marg Acton-Adams
reviews.snippet:
I had had dentures for 50 years, so when I first visited Richard Greenlees at Lovebite 11 years ago my face had sunk to quite an extent. The new dentures Richard sculptured for me made me very happy for the way they lifted my face, so going back 10 years later when my teeth were not fitting as well as they had been was a very simple decision.
We had an in-depth consultation at Lovebite, with Richard explaining the three options he had for me. On deciding to go with the Oral Lift level of treatment, Richard outlined the full procedure which included changing the look of my mouth back to resemble my youth. He has certainly achieved this for me, and this has helped my confidence immensely.
Initially I had to persevere with fitting the new dentures to my gums, it was an unusual feeling to get used to, I did achieve this significant change and now the fit is perfect with no looseness whatsoever.
I have no hesitation in recommending Richard to anybody should they ask me, his professionalism through out has been excellent. As I opted for the ultimate facial rebuild to be still receiving compliments a year later gives me great confidence and I am extremely pleased with the results.

reviews.author: Kaz Hendriks
reviews.snippet:
After 10 years of wearing badly fitting dentures I was suffering with very little confidence in myself. I did not eat out with friends i did not ever smile in public I was so ashamed of my teeth and I avoided mirrors at all costs.
Sitting in a doctors waiting room one day 8years ago I picked up a magazine and saw an advert from lovebite. It took me weeks to pluck up the courage to make an appointment.
After that first appointment I really felt there was hope. Richard was so reassuring confident and professional. He made me feel like his only client ever and was determined to give me my smile and confidence back.
After approx 8 weeks I had the most amazing set of dentures in my mouth that I had ever seen. They fitted perfectly almost like putting on a great fitting glove.
However, I didn't just get new amazing dentures. I got ME back again.
I felt like a totally new person and no longer shy'd away from opening my mouth to smile. In fact I haven't stopped smiling since and my confidence levels soared. I am often complimented on my beautiful smile and that is all down to you Richard.

I had to have a second set of dentures made recently as I smashed my front teeth falling over and yet again another amazing job.
From the bottom of my  heart I thank you for all you have done for me. You are truly amazing and I would recommend you to anyone.❤❤❤

reviews.author: Stacey Adams
reviews.snippet: Richard has been so great to work with. Since retiring one thing my Mum wanted was a new set of teeth. Richard was so calm, patient and really worked with Mum to make sure he got everything perfect. Mum left feeling a lot more confident and proud of herself. The difference in her smile has been huge. Thank you Richard. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Francie Thomas
reviews.snippet:
My journey with Richard started after 10 yrs of pain from ill fitting dentures.
I now have beautiful teeth and a smile to match,.I look and feel years younger.
My Family and Friends  also love the transformation.
Thank you Richard

reviews.author: Kathy Beswick
reviews.snippet:
I was well overdue for replacement dentures so began researching through the available websites.  I was intrigued enough by what I read on Lovebite’s website to book an initial appointment with Richards Greenlees. I’m very glad that I did.
This particular journey can be a bit of an emotional one for those of us that wear dentures. Years of being self-conscious about smiling, being photographed, increasing difficulty with eating and the loss of facial structure had affected my self-esteem. Richard changed all of that for me.  He recreated my original smile with a more natural appearance & feel than I’ve had previously. Richard’s prodigious technical skills combined with his artistic and creative talent ensured that I have a new confidence in the way I look and feel. Yes, it was a larger investment in myself than I’d planned for but I don’t regret it for a minute.
I can’t recommend Richard Greenlees at Lovebite highly enough.
Kathryn B

reviews.author: Rosemary Martini
reviews.snippet:
Over many years I have a number of dentures and suffered greatly. Then I was so lucky to have found Richard. I now have beautiful teeth with no pain whatsoever, I can eat anything. Even my grand children and friends tell me how great they look. More to the point, how much younger I look. Thank you Richard I will continue to tell my friends you are the best.
Rosemary

reviews.author: Sharon Spyve
reviews.snippet:
UPDATE -  9/10/20 - I have been in touch with Richard from Love Bite and he has now refunded me the cost of the denture, there is still an amount outstanding which he has assured me he will refund upon return of the denture he made, once I have a new denture made elsewhere.
Interestingly, after placing my original review, I was contacted by another person who has also had exactly the same experience that I did.
-----

1 & a half years later after beginning my procedure with Love Bite I am still extremely unhappy with the outcome.  Richard denied that I was retching to the point of vomiting all the time because the denture was sitting far too back in my mouth.  After over 1 year of this he rectified it, however I have constantly had a top denture that moves all the time, whenever I eat, the gum part of the denture is way too long depthwise which means I look really ''gummy'' when I smile, and i have a massive overbite with my top teeth.
Richard made a beautiful job of the actual teeth but he never was able to get the fit or size right for me, which is surprising considering the years and expertise he sold himself on - to the tune of $16,500.
He then gave up on me because he says he has done everything he can.
If he only listened to me instead of insisting he was right, I'm sure my issues could have been rectified and I would not now be going to someone else to get a new denture made.
This has been a very costly and unfortunate exercise for me - I thought I was going to the best - but he doesn't listen and in fact argues with you when you try to explain how the denture is feeling and how it is really difficult to eat in front of people because your top teeth just fall out of your mouth.
He definitely did not fit the denture properly to my mouth and I'm gutted with my whole experience.
I personally, unfortunately, would not recommend, and I'm sure Richard will reply with a comeback but please don't take that on board.
I gave him 1.5 years to sort the issues I was having, and he didn't.

reviews.author: Rosie Wilson
reviews.snippet:

Since going to Richard I have had a lot of people notice my eyelashes, my eyes,my skin, my glasses, my smile, they have notice a difference in me ,the difference is my teeth,  I even feel taller my confidence has lifted that much, I feel so brilliant and pretty .
Thank you Richard.

He offers up confidence and achieves this to the highest level. the only other thing I can say is Thank you!!!

Thank you Richard for a really good experience.

Marie Hopkins

I would like to have a discussion with you about dental implants.

Questions for  you and your dental team:

How many years of experience does the surgeon have?

How many dental implant procedures does the surgeon complete a year?

What is the surgeon’s success rate?

What do they attribute that to?
It's hoped that the above review will help others make more informed decisions when considering dental implants.

reviews.author: Pilli India
reviews.snippet:
My visit to Garden City Dentals came after a deeply distressing and disappointing journey elsewhere, and I feel compelled to share this experience because it restored my trust in dental care.
I developed a dental issue three months after my triple-bypass heart surgery, a time when any medical decision requires extreme care and sensitivity. I first visited another dentist, carefully handed over my complete medical file, underwent routine checks and three X-rays, and was advised to see a dental specialist. I was prescribed painkillers and billed accordingly. Though unsatisfied, I followed their recommendation.
The very next day, I visited the referred specialist clinic. Even before meeting the specialist, I was directed to undergo multiple X-rays and a 180-degree scan, resulting in a heavy bill. When I was finally called in, the specialist barely looked at me, did not review my medical records, and abruptly declared that nothing could be done because it was only three months after my heart surgery. I was sent out without discussion or explanation. I walked away feeling robbed, unheard, and deeply discouraged.
Seeking another opinion, I approached a different dentist. To my shock, they contacted the previous dentist without my consent to ask why I had not returned. At that point, I felt my privacy had been breached, and my confidence in the system was completely shaken.
That is when I walked into Garden City Dentals during afterhours—and everything changed.
From the very first interaction, the reception staff were cheerful, calm, and transparent, patiently explaining the process and putting me at ease. I was then seen by Dr Swati Kadian, whose approach was a complete contrast to what I had experienced before. She carefully examined me, reviewed my medical history, and only then suggested X-rays—clearly explaining why they were needed, the costs involved, the number of visits required, and the treatment options available, including the immediate denture method.
What stood out most was her professional diagnosis and prognosis—confident, thorough, and deeply reassuring. Given my recent heart surgery, I insisted on seeing a specialist, but Dr Kadian honestly and calmly declined, explaining that it was not necessary and that she was fully confident in managing my case safely. That clarity itself was comforting.
On the day of the extraction (three tooth from the upper jaw), her skill truly spoke for itself. The procedure was remarkably smooth and gentle. Her hands felt almost magical. At the slightest indication of discomfort, she immediately responded with additional anaesthesia, ensuring I felt no pain. Her approach was delicate, attentive, and compassionate throughout.
After months of anxiety, confusion, and disappointment, Garden City Dentals—and especially Dr Swati Kadian—gave me something invaluable: confidence, dignity, and relief. This was not just dental treatment; it was care delivered with integrity and humanity.
I am profoundly grateful and would wholeheartedly recommend Garden City Dentals to anyone, especially those with complex medical histories who need not just treatment but understanding and trust. Splendid work, keep it up, team!

reviews.snippet:
After visiting my local dentist and getting a rather big quote for some teeth repairs l was recommended to try Waltham Dentistry.
WOW.
This practise got me in for a consultation,explained what were the issues,the repair costs and how soon they could fit me in.
Plus a great follow up service.
Thank you Barbara and your team for a very professional job done for me with no more teeth issues to date.
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Katie Sullivan
reviews.snippet: Today I saw Wei Ping for my first ever filling. She and the dental assistant were lovely! I am a very anxious person and they did their best to put me at ease and helped me and encouraged me through the procedure. They explained everything and didn't judge me for my lack of knowledge or nervous questions. I would definitely recommend. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jackie Boon
reviews.snippet:
I have been going to this dental practise for many many years. In more recent years, I have been treated by both Barbara AND Nick. Each time I was treated with both gentleness and kindness. Their professionalism was second to none. The best practise I have attended. and I  will keep
coming back!
Thank you Barbara and Nick.

reviews.author: Tatiana Guzman
reviews.snippet: Barbara is the best professional I have ever seen. She has treated me for the last two years. She has done periodic general checkins and repairs, she always ensures the quality of her work even if several visits are required. She also fixed some poor quality implants that another dentist put in, which wore out, cracked and broke. My front teeth look like new!

reviews.author: Laura Richmond
reviews.snippet: Barbara and the entire Waltham Team are absolutely fantastic. She explains the entire procedure to you as a patient and she is the only dentist my daughter will go to. I have and will continue to recommended her to other family and friends.

reviews.author: Paul Connor
reviews.snippet: I've been a patient at Waltham Dental for a few years now and have always been well looked after.  What I am particularly impressed with is the help and advice they (both dentist and hygeinist) have given me around preventative maintenance (brushing and flossing techniques) which means that I am now taking better care of my teeth than ever which results in fewer visits to the dentist in the long term.

reviews.author: Ada Campbell
reviews.snippet: After three years since attending a Dental Surgery, I decided to make an appointment with Barbara Nieh at Waltham Dental Centre on the glowing reports I have had from others who had already 'discovered' Barbara. I can't speak highly enough of the profession manner Barbara deals with her patients. I felt totally relaxed throughout the  consultation, everything was explained to me in terms I understood, not at all was I made to feel uncomfortable or anxious, I came away with a 'good feel' about my first consult, so much so I made an immediate decision to make Barbara my 'new' dentist.

reviews.author: Mahalia Eade
reviews.snippet: Great dental centre! Going to the dentist is always a nerve wrecking experience for me, but Nick is so kind and lovely and makes you feel like you're in safe hands! His assistant Adrienne is also very friendly. Rachel the hygenist again is lovely and very professional, and you're always greeted by the sweet Jess at reception! Awesome team that makes you feel comfortable, thank you guys! :)

reviews.author: Wayne Glover
reviews.snippet: I have been coming to this dentist for the last few years for and always had great service. Barbara was able to see me urgently when I had chipped some teeth over the holiday period and did a great job. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Anna & Chris
reviews.snippet: I've been a patient at Waltham Dental for over five years. The dentists and hygienists I’ve seen during this time have each been exceptionally friendly, professional and gentle in their technique. I appreciate their conservative approach to dental work, and I’ve had at least one tooth saved as a result. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Emily Ross
reviews.snippet: Nick and abbey are AWESOME! I am beyond happy with my experience with them today. Thank you Waltham Dental!

reviews.author: Kim Willems
reviews.snippet: I would highly recommend Waltham Dental Centre. I have been attending this centre for many years, and have always had great tenants and excellent care, right from the front desk staff, hygienists, and now with my current dentist Dr Nick Wong. Nick takes the time to explain procedures, and has an extremely professional and caring manner. When specialist treatment is needed referral and follow up is very quick. An all-round excellent dental centre!

reviews.author: Fiona Lewis
reviews.snippet:
when I first came to this dentist, I had been to 2 others that week with severe trust issues with dentists, and thought I was in really good hands but not even close, The Grossest of neglect actioned by this husband and wife team. I was told I needed a crown, by my endodontist on a re treatment root canal, this lot recommended 3 crowns of the 3 teeth next to each other, at a cost of $4.5k. Turns out one of the crowns was put on a tooth with clear signs of infection, the upper right 1st molar, that also had a root canal.
I don't trust these people they are extremely negligent and I have had huge consequences because of it. Fatigue, pain, ear issues, bleeding as well as handing over $4.5k likely for crowns that were not even necessary. They have been contacted by the endodontist  and a solution is being sort. I would never EVER trust these negligent people who don't deserve to practise. I better not discover any other health issues as a result of a compromised immune system. The endodontist was sympathetic and understood that this should NEVER have happened. They only get 1 star as I have to click it to leave a review. Run as far as you can from this grossly incompetent team, that could end up costing you your health. How dare you!  17/12/23  A full reimbursement was sought, to get this situation fixed, Barbara wanted me to wait for her to speak to endodontist, I did, then she requested I wait further as she speaks to someone else, I just wanted to be free of this bunch and get my money to fix the issue myself, Barbara refused, on 21/12/23. I was advised to contact her given this information and offer her an opportunity to fix this 22/12/23 at 10.41am, and this request has been ignored. It was received as I received a further email from them at 11.35am with some of my xrays and history. One xray has had the date changed on it. I visited another dentist, contacted a lawyer and the dental council to put things in place to put this right. My gum has been bleeding today 22/12/23. All I ever needed from these guys is my money back, so I could get a new dentist that I trust, to pull the infected, root canal molar they crowned, out and get a false tooth to replace.If they had of done this, this entire drama would be over. I have been extremely distressed over this. Watch this space, I look forward to an outcome asap. Update on 27/12/23 I got a cone beam CT scan, to see exactly what is going on in molar 16 and sure enough as evidenced and witnessed in xrays there is a long standing infection present that has been giving me increasing issues for years. This should have been investigated and communicated to me, as I would NEVER a. allow an infection in my mouth and b. allow a dentist to put a crown, at a cost of $1450 on said tooth with infection, that will now have to be either removed or re root canal meaning drilling through the crown. This crown should NEVER have been done and the infection should have been sorted. Over to you Barbara, to fix.

reviews.author: Nathan Lewis
reviews.snippet: Barbara, we are astounded that you have left our Mum, open to an infection that could potentially be life threatening. It's as though you don't even know her, she is a health freak. Her focus is gut health and immune support. Yet here she is with infected, bleeding gums that you knew could develop and you didn't warn her, and now she is massively suffering. This is so darn wrong Barbara. We want our Mum around for years to come. At the very least, you need to take responsibility for an infection you knew was there, didn't tell her, and now is making her distressed and sick. Us kids are not happy when our Mum is suffering. She looks tired and skinny yet on her birthday Dec 8th she looked amazing. She doesn't deserve this. Put it right. Stop her stress and infection. She is going to hospital.

reviews.author: Bill Hewat
reviews.snippet: I had a tooth that had been giving me trouble for over 3-years, but despite seeing five different dentists, including an orthodontist, no one could identify or remedy the problem.  However,  all that changed when I saw Barbara Nieh at Waltham Dental, who quickly located the problem and fixed it.  The treatment was very professional and I am extremely grateful to her that I can now chew food on both sides of my mouth without pain.

reviews.author: Alys Hill
reviews.snippet: The service here, is actually exceptional. ALMOST makes going to the dentist, pleasant. Every dentist there is professional, extremely kind, does an excellent job and is in no way judgemental or condescending (even if you're not as regular in attendance as you know you should). Can't thank this awesome team enough for their care and brilliant service.

reviews.author: Sylvia Nissen
reviews.snippet: I've been a patient at the Waltham Dental Centre for the last 15 years and I always had outstanding service and care. The staff are excellent, very professional, friendly and kind. They are also extremely gentle, which I appreciate in a dentist!

reviews.author: Helen Rutter
reviews.snippet: Absolutely brilliant dentists. I had a bad experience with another dentist and now travel halfway across the city to see Nick who very kindly and sympathetically fixed up a mess.  So thankful I found this practice. Wouldn't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Kirsten Straker
reviews.snippet: ❤️ I have been going to Waltham Dentist for 20 years now I have always found them to be not only professional in their work but caring, my once anxious kids enjoy coming to see Barbara and the team. We are almost part of the family 😂 we have appreciated everything you have done for us 👍

reviews.author: Caitlin Roberts
reviews.snippet:
FANTASTIC! have now started to love going to the dentist to get work done and to go for check ups. Barbara is so lovely and makes the whole time you’re there go fast and enjoyable.

Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ezra (Nicekiwi)
reviews.snippet: Very professional, empathetic, and friendly treatment. I always fear the dentist, but Doctor Nick always puts those fears to rest. Their receptionists and technicians are caring and friendly too.

reviews.author: Emma Green
reviews.snippet: I’ve been going to the team at Waltham Dental for many years and they are all incredible. There is no other practise I’d trust to look after me and my teeth.

reviews.author: Jenny Huang

reviews.snippet: Great dentist.

reviews.author: Gerry Vargas
reviews.snippet: I was here this afternoon. They are very professional and kind. My family knows them as excellent dentists and very reliable in their work. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Soul Name
reviews.snippet: A very, skilled  dentist, been with for over 20 years apart from a gap time of a few years living away, where, during this time, I have never found another dental practice of this high caliber. I’m  a very grateful and satisfied patient of Graeme and Emmy of Warrington Dental.

reviews.author: Roachy
reviews.snippet: “I have been seeing Emmy & Graeme for over 28 years - ever since my eldest son Shannen who is now 32 was just 4 years old. On top of that, their prices are always affordable & fair. It’s rare to find dentists who combine such professionalism, kindness & long-term trust. I truely wouldn’t go anywhere else & highly recommended Emmy & Graeme for anyone looking for a family dentist you can rely on for life.”

reviews.author: Nick John
reviews.snippet:
You get what you pay for. The dentist was half asleep and they didn't know what I'd booked in for, telling me I was there for a hygiene session which I'd had a couple months ago.
XRAYed the same side twice by mistake and when I questioned why they hadn't done the other side, he insisted he had. Had to push them to check their system before they recognized their mistake. Their apology was not charging me for the extra unneeded x-ray. Wow amazing. Won't go here again.

reviews.author: Chris Hannay
reviews.snippet: My family and I have been going to Warrington Dental Clinic for 20 years. In my opinion they are great for me in affordability and always fix the problem where others could not. They have done wonderful work on my teeth and are particular and fussy and always strive to do their best. Very happy with them and always tell others about them. Have known to be busy but can imagine why,  but is honestly worth the wait, Forgot to mention, they are super kind and make you feel at home, look forward to seeing them for the next 20 years. Thanks guys

reviews.author: Wendy Griffiths
reviews.snippet: I will not go back again. The dentist was a butcher when removing one of my from teeth. He kept rubbing up against my gum which hurt like he'll and wouldn't stop. There was no dental nurse in the appointment.  I guess you pay cheaper prices and therefore get a bad experience

reviews.author: Richard Smith
reviews.snippet: Excellent service from front of house (reception/nurse) to front of mouth (gentle patient dentist)  Split my lip and needed a few stitches urgently. No one else could be bothered, GP didn't even ring back, but these guys made it happen. Very kind and honest people, just found my new dentist.

reviews.author: Joe Slade (SLADEX)
reviews.snippet: Came here while waiting on call for a dropped appointment by someone else. They slotted me in & provided a great service. Very thoughtful and kind staff. Recommend highly, will go again next time

reviews.author: Zhaohua Li
reviews.snippet: The dentist is very nice, professional and kind. It is run by a couple. The wife as assistant helps all the way and charge very reasonable price. The only downside is the long waiting list. So, book early if you need dental treatment.

reviews.author: Thomas Edward King
reviews.snippet: I've been seeing Emmy and Graham for over 30 years and you could not meet a more professional and caring team. They are as honest as the day is long. They have huge hearts and they'll go leaps and bounds for their patients. The world needs more kinds souls like these.

reviews.author: Stephen Carlton
reviews.snippet: Graham and Emmy are a great team providing an excellent, professional and friendly service. I’m thrilled with the restorative dental work I’ve had done. Their costs are incredibly reasonable and I wouldn’t go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Othniel Cressy
reviews.snippet: I would recommend them for their great service and work but that would mean that the waiting list of Christchurch's best kept dental secret would grow past 6 weeks. :-)

reviews.author: Neil Robinson
reviews.snippet: I want to thank Remy and Graham for fitting me in and fixed my broken tooth you are the best highly recommended

reviews.author: Rangi Pio
reviews.snippet: This has been my dentist for 15+yrs and the service has always been at high standards and reception/dental assistance is excellent to deal with when arranging appointments. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Rachel Hagenaar
reviews.snippet: Amazing price , lovely couple and genuinely care about you and don't want to take all your money . Affordable for everyone !! Will tell everyone about this place !

Really good

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.snippet:
Visited some weeks ago, I'm sure I came off as a bit stupid in retrospect, but the dentist I saw took the time to explain what my issues were, discouraged me from getting fillings when they're not needed and generally left me feeling happy with the service.

My wait time was a month, but my issue was not urgent.

reviews.author: Paula Griffiths
reviews.snippet: An awesome Dental Surgery.  From x-rays to extractions.  Fillings to fittings.  No complaints.  Anaesthesia is administered painlessly and effectively.  Communication is so important for peace of mind throughout any procedure and Dr Colin is so awesome at keeping you informed at every stage.  I highly recommend this practice and wouldn't hesitate to go back for any further treatment.

reviews.author: Jemima Rains
reviews.snippet:
I have been coming to this practice for almost 20 years and always receive great care and exceptional service. The staff are friendly and very professional, and Dr Colin always takes the time to explain thoroughly the outcome of check-ups and x-rays.
I wouldn't consider going anywhere else and have no problem recommending the centre to anyone else!

reviews.author: Sharlyn Chand
reviews.snippet: I recently had all my wisdom teeth removed at Windsor Dental. Having had bad experiences with other dentists in the past, i am very pleased that i chose Windsor Dental for my extractions. Dr Colin was so patient with me ( i was super anxious). The friendly atmosphere at the clinic helped me relax during the procedure. I will be booking another appointment with Dr Colin for my braces after my recovery. Thank you Dr Colin and Team.

reviews.author: Bronwyn Price
reviews.snippet: I could not recommend Windsor dental enough, the staff are amazing and Dr Colin is fantastic, having had bad experiences with dentists in the past, I was so nervous and anxious, Colin is so understanding and makes sure you are ok and keeps you calm and relaxed. His pain free techniques are next level. If you want a dentist that actually gets to know his patients and takes pride in what they do,  💯 recommend going to see Colin and his team.

reviews.author: J B
reviews.snippet: Absolutely fantastic for young children. Sarah and Colin made what could have been a really upsetting experience for mu toddler into a fun experience where he didn't want to leave. Blown away by their kindness and thoughtfulness. Couldn't recommend highly enough.

reviews.author: Samantha Kirkman
reviews.snippet: I am someone who hates needles and getting any procedures done at the dentist so when I found out I needed to get a tooth extracted I was extremely nervous. The only way I thought I could cope was getting put to sleep but Colin reassured me that it would be pain free while getting the injections and tooth out. On the day I was crying before I even got there but as soon as he saw me, he was very understanding of my nerves and found ways to make me feel at ease during the extraction and in fact I didn’t even know he had given me one injection until after he told me, didn’t feel a single thing. Highly recommend him to anyone who is scared of the dentist like me, he is honestly the best as well as the rest of the staff !

reviews.author: Mike Southworth
reviews.snippet: I have to start by admitting that i do not generally like 'the dentist chair' and have managed to get to quite an age avoiding dental practices where possible. Colin and his team have been treating me for the last month and have put me at ease, been kind, professional and explained each step of my plan carefully. I am in the process of having many filling replaced and some new fillings in a short time frame. I was recommended Colin and his team and have confidence in the great work they are doing for me. I would like to recommend this dental practice to anyone :)

reviews.author: Joe Greaves
reviews.snippet:
Colin and his team are fantastic. It's hands down the best dentist I've ever been to. He's straight to the point in the nicest way.
I totally recommend his practise.

reviews.author: MJ *
reviews.snippet:
Colin!!!!One of the Best Dentist!!!
M usually very anxious and always like to avoid medical treatments especially root canal etc
My case was bit frustrating too yet Dr.Colin and his team made it comfortable (providing I was 32 wks pregnant )
My experience at Windsor was simply remarkable!!
Amazing team .Recommended

reviews.author: Steven A. Sequeira
reviews.snippet: First, my disclaimer. I am Colin's first cousin. I have used other dentists decades ago, but started using Colin's services as we now lived nearby to him. His knowledge, skill and care is second to none and my search for a reliable dentist ended a long time back. Thanks cuzzie. You are tops!

reviews.author: Paul Lodge
reviews.snippet: Colin is an excellent dentist, in fact world class, which is why I have been going to him for about 10 years, and I highly recommend his practice. I used to travel from the other side of Christchurch, and now travel from Melbourne. He has the highest professional standards, his prices are very fair, he explains things well, and gives comprehensive after care advice. For example, work done elsewhere without proper reinforcement resulted in a tooth breaking off after only a week, but Colin built a new one on the stump for a fraction of the cost of an implant, and it is still going strong after several years. He is the gentlest dentist you could hope to meet, and I have actually fallen asleep while he worked on my teeth! He has a great team, who in my experience have been a pleasure to deal with, and Colin clearly enjoys investing in their professional development. He would be a great asset to the teaching staff at Otago University's school of dentistry if he joined them (as a teenager I received my dental care there, then trained at the neighbouring medical school). And as a doctor who worked in Melbourne through the COVID 19 pandemic without getting sick, I can also commend the hygiene standards at Windsor Dental as impeccable.

reviews.author: Lisa Funnell
reviews.snippet: 5 stars for a dentist appointment? What? Seriously the best experience I've ever had seeing a dentist. I'm afraid of needles, don't like pain and avoid dentists until I need extraction. He said he could do the injection and extraction pain-free and I didn't believe him. After the first injection I was shocked as he truly did make it pain free.  Tooth was out before I knew it. Amazing service, lovely staff, dental mastery. Patient for life now and I won't hesitate in making an appointment.  Highly recommend. AAA +++

reviews.author: Carissa Brant
reviews.snippet:
Colin and his team are AMAZING!
I was super nervous about my first extraction ( not being sedated ) but Colin and his team made me feel so calm that I had no idea when the tooth was actually out, Ive been coming here for the past two years for all my dental needs and will be for the many more to come!!

reviews.author: Shaz Keir
reviews.snippet: Highly recommend Colin and his team to anyone who wants to walk out the door with a smile on their faces. I have been coming here for just over a year for braces and I would be kicking myself if I went anywhere else! Thank you so much Colin, Tracey and Ash for the exceptional service every time. You have gained a customer for life :)

reviews.author: Evarist DeSouza
reviews.snippet: Colin is very professional and an excellent dentist. He's done a couple of crowns and root canals for me with perfection. He's been my dentist for a long time and I won't be going anywhere else. He is also excellent with children. Very reasonably priced .

reviews.author: Vladimir Ivanov
reviews.snippet: Colin at Windsor Dental Centre is a real professional. What a great experience. They have the newest dentist X-ray machine and once the x-ray is taken it is ready and they explain to you what the problems may be and what is the best way of fixing it. All the staff were friendly too. I found my dream dentist 🦷 🙂👌

reviews.author: Carrie M
reviews.snippet: After years of putting off going to the Dentist, I have been pleasantly surprised how painless and easy the experience is. The staff are all lovely and welcoming and Colin is amazing. Thank you so much for your wonderful care.

reviews.author: max palmer
reviews.snippet:
Colin Viegas is a both a professional dentist and an inspiration to many in the ethical and caring ways with which  he conducts his practice. He gets 15+ out of 10 !
Why go anywhere else when you are in the hands of a great dentist!
His present staff team including the inimitable Sara are great !

reviews.author: Sandra Palmer
reviews.snippet: I find that the dental care I receive at Windsor Dental Centre is 2nd to none . Colin Viegas is both very professional & also very personable as are the rest of his staff .. He takes great attention to detail from start to finish, is very calm & calming  & I have total confidence in his ability to give me gold star dental care . Although I have to cross the city to go there I find it is more than well worth the effort .

reviews.author: Aaron Goodwin
reviews.snippet:
Have been in an out of hospital for cancer investigations and severe allergic reactions over the past few months, going through MRI scans, ultrasounds (multiple) and biopsies. Anxiously awaiting results and dealing with all sorts of related matters on the side.

As you can imagine, remembering to keep my scheduled dental appointments was the last thing on my mind during this ongoing ordeal. Having completely missed and forgotten about 2x appointments, Windsor Dental have elected to leave me with a half-finished, pre-paid for treatment (have deposited $1200) and kick me off their patient list with pending refund, minus the missed appointment fees. This is despite having the situation explained to them.

Inconsiderate, unreasonable, unprofessional and outright unpleasant. A business that puts money before patient welfare, even in extraordinary circumstances such as this has no place practicing in close community city like Christchurch.

Bar extreme cases, they also don't tend to "believe" in pain management medication (note big flashing neon Jesus sign in the window). Very weird vibe. Feels like stepping back in time.

Absolutely shameful.

---------------------

UPDATE: As Google doesn't give me the option to respond to Windsor Dentists reply -

What a polite and detailed response from the practice to this review. While not accurate, it's a much better and more polite explanation than recieved on the phone, although I'm sure this difference in customer service has nothing to do with the fact that this medium is public.

My situation was indeed explained to your practice, as was the reason I did not make contact.

After missing the first appointment I called the practice, explained why and re-booked. The second missed appointment was the only one for which you recieved a delayed,  but in most people's eyes understandable explanation. For the majority of the lockdown period and until recently my partner Ivy and I only shared a phone (using her number) after breaking mine, so my Sim card was only inserted periodically which is why your text reminders fell through the cracks. Ivy was in the middle of trying to explain things to whoever it was she got on the phone from your practice, but kept being rudely cut off.

Your response to this review focuses a lot on justifying deducting the costs of the missed appointments from my refund, despite that only getting a brief mention in my original review. I was not complaining about this deduction as it's perfectly reasonable. I was complaining about the fact I was kicked off your patient list mid-treatment for such a minor offence caused by extreme circumstances. Your focus on the missed appointments costs speaks further to my claim that you're more concerned about the financial side of things than the patient experience.

Regardless of your own subjective view, my partner and I both feel your handling of this situation has been extreme, unforgiving and outright cold. I don't believe you know what it is to operate as a wholesome, community-minded business.

I look forward to my refund and completeting my treatment at a more suitable and professional practice.

reviews.author: Ivy Fitzgerald
reviews.snippet: Rude reception staff when speaking on the phone. Cash is king here. The customer is the lowest priority. Have treated my family poorly in the short time we have dealt with this business. I'm someone who has moved around a lot between Dunedin and Auckland and I've never dealt with practice staff like this before. I'm glad I've only witnessed and heard their customer service and only dealt with it over the phone rather than being a paying patient on the end of it. I would literally rather go anywhere else, and we will.

reviews.author: wayford ford
reviews.snippet: This dentist my goodness.  They are incredible people,  they did treatment over many weeks for my son Jason,  his hoodie was torn and they blessed him with a new one, they really cared about my son and have given his smile back

reviews.author: Tarryn Berg
reviews.snippet: Not only was the service unprofessional and unhygienic but the cost was grossly overpriced. The woman receptionist had poor English and argumentative.
