reviews.author: Mrs Kiesanowski
reviews.snippet: After hearing horrific stories from friends about other dentists I have recommended Windsor to several people. I have always been looked after and had work done on several occasions.

reviews.author: James Johnson

reviews.author: Andy McKay
reviews.snippet:
I have had the pleasure of receiving fine dentistry from Colin Viegas over approximately 15yrs.
I have enjoyed a pleasant and often humorous relationship with this fine dentist until his wife Sara / receptionist who has always been bumptious and rude despite my impeccable manners and perfect payment history began telling blatant lies.
Eg:
For no apparent reason with no notice whatsoever she sends me my dental records and asks me to find another dentist based on the untruth that they are
“downsizing.”
I gave her the opportunity to explain this immediate dumping of a well paying customer of 15yrs and received zero response.
Since March 2026 up until 2 days ago i’ve had to get 2-3 friends to call Windsor Dental enquiring if they’re taking on new patients to which Sara or Sarah (she’s always been unsure of her own name) has responded yes to 3 separate enquiries over as many months that “yes we are taking on new patients.”
This is professional misconduct at the least and dangerous and disgusting behaviour at the worst.
Colin must know of this via my emails and texts about the situation.
Most unfortunately he has become complicit in what are now a legal proceedings.
This once fine establishment has dropped to the lowest level possible in my view, thus being gross dishonesty.
Stay posted to see the eventual outcome.
Shame on both these
so called christians.

reviews.author: Tina M
reviews.snippet:
If dental courage were a mountain, I used to be stuck at the base — panicking, catastrophising, and crafting last‑minute cancellation texts in my head. Enter Hamish and his spectacular team — precision‑driven, Type‑A perfectionists
with hearts as kind as their clinical skills are sharp.
Special mention to Emily, whose gentle presence could calm even the most "fight‑or‑flight" patient (hi, that’s me).
She and Hamish have a trained eye for spotting every tiny non‑verbal cue — the stiff shoulders, the white‑knuckled hands,
the “I’m smiling but also internally screaming” face.
They notice it all before you even realise you’re doing it.
And then they respond with care so genuine you end up relaxing without even meaning to. Hamish doesn’t just treat teeth —
he takes the time to explain every step, every product, every tool, every reason why. Ask him about prosthodontic ceramics
and he will gladly launch into a full PhD‑level lecture. (Sorry Hamish — I know it was your doctor thesis, but I remember exactly none of the science. Still appreciate the passion though!)
For the first time in my entire dental history, I didn’t cancel a single appointment out of sheer panic. That alone deserves a national award.
And as much as I can confidently say this has been the best dental experience of my life. I also sincerely hope I don’t need to see them too soon again. Nothing personal — I just prefer my teeth behaving themselves.
If you’re looking for professionalism, kindness, precision, and a team who treat you like a human being instead of a dental chart — Nelson Prosthodontists is the place.
Five beautifully polished stars.

I was intending to keep the appointment in order to get a full check up. There was no care at any point, the pain was horrific and no one at Cooper and Hunt cared. I have recommended my family move dentists as this was totally unacceptable. I lost 3kg in four days from not being able to eat and then to be berated by someone I don’t know and who denied me an appointment when I needed it the most? Appalling.

reviews.author: Shyla Nicole
reviews.snippet:
Update 2025: the bottom review here is from two years ago. Two years later I am still visiting Cooper & Hunt Oamaru. I have officially been cured of my phobia of the dentist. The team here have been absolutely AMAZING. They are so calm, patient, kind & understanding. If you are afraid to see the dentist then I very highly recommend Cooper & Hunt Oamaru. They will not continue working on your teeth if you feel afraid. They will immediately stop what they are doing to provide care & reassurance when you are feeling overwhelmed with fear. The ladies in reception are wonderful, very warm & welcoming. The dental assistants do an incredible job supporting the dentist while they work on your teeth. I never thought I would ever see the day that not only would I not need sedation, but that I would actually look forward to going to the dentist. I very highly recommend anyone & everyone to go to Cooper & Hunt Oamaru.

First posted two years ago:
Very anxious about visiting the dentist, yet the entire team at Cooper & Hunt are kind, compassionate & understanding. I have been treated with the utmost care by everyone from the administrative staff,.to the dental assistants and the dentists. Tammy has helped me to resolve my phobia of the dentist office. I highly recommend Cooper & Hunt, and have nothing but positive things to say about all of them. Thank you team 😊

reviews.author: joy may
reviews.snippet: All round great experience, very caring, chatty always making sure the customer is comfortable throughout the whole time there.

reviews.author: Samantha Baker
reviews.snippet: Best dental experience I've had in a long time. Matt and his team were so kind and friendly. I really appreciate how Matt talked me through everything and explained what he was doing and why. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bev Grieve
reviews.snippet:
Had appointments december ,January(2) and march then with hygienists. Would highly recommendmat mat and  annabel very caring people. Hygienists Anna not good. All appointments paid as leaving building. Then 8 may  get an email saying they forgot to add  one appointment in January when I paid  . 10 weeks after the appointment. Didn't even have decency to phone me???? Not good.
Have had ph call from Fern on 18 may  and she was not happy with what happened.
Account has been retracted and apology has been accepted. Cheers Fern

reviews.author: Whirly Murley
reviews.snippet: On Time and  made to feel at ease. Dr Matt was awesome once again and explains everything from start to finish

reviews.author: Finn Carter
reviews.snippet:
Gotta take my hat off to Matt and his assistant, honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Matt is one of the friendliest and most understanding guys I’ve come across. He’s calm, confident, and explains everything so clearly throughout the whole process, which makes a massive difference when you’re a bit on edge.

5 Stars, Cheers team

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.snippet: Bridget and the rest of the team were all so nice and welcoming!

reviews.author: Diane Cadwallader
reviews.snippet: Greeted by the lovely reception staff, helpful, warm and relaxed environment. The staff were very professional and communicated everything respectful and calmly. Certainly recommend.

reviews.author: Sally R
reviews.snippet: We had such a wonderful experience. My neurodivergent son has a real fear of the dentist and woke up with a toothache this morning, so we were quite worried. The clinic kindly fit us in for an urgent appointment to see a dentist, and she was incredibly patient, gentle, and understanding with him. We’re very grateful, Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: noelene grennell
reviews.snippet: Thank you Bridget and The Dream Team.  Best dentist I've been to in 89 years.  Thank you both so much. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Callie Lomas
reviews.snippet: Best experience with a dentist to date. I dealt with Mike Smith the periodontal expert and I could not fault him. Great advise , great work and did everything to make this situation comfortable. The dental assistance team also great and reception team wonderful . Highly recommend

reviews.author: Lilly
reviews.snippet: Mike and Adele were amazing to deal with. Well worth the trips down to Dunedin to have them look after my implant journey (with fabulous results!)

reviews.author: Jamie Anderson
reviews.snippet: Was enquiring for dental work. Was looking in the wrong place but the team called back with 24 hours and referred me to the correct people. Nice customer support. Lovely to talk to. Thanks, Team.

reviews.author: Ben M
reviews.snippet: Hygiene appointment with Nicky was amazing. She was very thorough and did a splendid job. If you're not making an appointment with her, you're missing out!

reviews.author: David Parker
reviews.snippet: I needed some work done over three appointments and was quoted a rough price. We made a VERBAL AGREEMENT that I could pay for this over time, and on the final, and largest, day of work the Manager phoned me and said I needed to pay in advance and get my account in credit before my work this afternoon. I shall not use your services again. If an agreement is made, if even verbally, it is a contract and this firm broke that contract. This work was already being paid for....

reviews.author: Kim Undy
reviews.snippet: Anna is well experienced and hence draws on that experience when she works on patients. She has a lovely manner to go with it. I have found she has been very helpful and reassuring when I have had questions about the treatments and procedures required.

reviews.author: Jordyn Tereu
reviews.snippet: First hygiene appointment with Anna and what a great experience it was! Friendly service, great at providing information on how to best take care of my oral hygiene and I absolutely loved the feeling of clean teeth after! 🤩 highly recommend and definitely will be back!

reviews.author: cherie Keen
reviews.snippet: Highly recommend Anna and Esther at Gentle Hygiene & Therapy, they provide a friendly relaxed environment with a high standard of professional care.

reviews.author: Ben Davies
reviews.snippet: Great dental practice - professional, friendly, and good value 👍

reviews.author: Michaela Cairns
reviews.snippet: Loved going to gentle hygiene! Excellent staff service, Anna was so good at making me feel comfortable, the appointment was gentle and easy! she also provided me with all the information I need to take care of my teeth. I would highly recommend Gentle Hygiene :) Thank you Anna for the wonderful experience and will be seeing you again.

reviews.author: Andrew Robinson
reviews.snippet: "At Gardens Dental we don’t just look after teeth, we look after you" - truer words were never spoken. With 90 minutes notice, Michelle had me booked in with Christian to have a filling filled. 2 hours later, I walked out, with both of them insisting my fee to be donated to Movember. If you live in Dunedin, or have any reason to visit Dunedin, these guys are worth visiting. I'll be making trips from Queenstown when I can to use these guys as my dentist from now on. Thank you a thousand times

reviews.author: EUNSIK KIM
reviews.snippet: I recently had the pleasure of visiting this dental clinic and was thoroughly impressed by the warmth and professionalism displayed by both the assistant and the dentist, Christian. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and respected, especially regarding my cultural preferences. Christian took the time to explain the procedures clearly and demonstrated excellent skills in addressing my dental needs. I'm very happy with my visit and grateful for the considerate and high-quality care provided. Highly recommend to anyone seeking a comfortable and understanding dental experience!

reviews.author: Andrew Perkins
reviews.snippet: Dr Simon Guan is brilliant. Today he removed a squamous papilloma from my throat, and the entire procedure was completely painless. A superb dentist too.

reviews.author: Tj Woodrow
reviews.snippet: Called on 5 seperate occasions at different times, call was never answered

reviews.author: WildFern
reviews.snippet:
I love my dentist and I love my teeth
For over 2 decades  I've gone here and I absolutely trust their judgment and care
It's very rare to have such good practice
With good admin and support staff would rate higher if I could thank you 😁

reviews.author: Karen Dwight
reviews.snippet: Always friendly, Great team

reviews.author: Vicci Holdsworth
reviews.snippet: Excellent service! Professional and friendly staff who genuinely care about your health and doing what is best for you. The woman I had showed me what she was doing to my tooth and helped me understand it all which was cool!

reviews.author: Hayley Graham
reviews.snippet: Amazing dentist been going here for over  10 years great people so lovely

reviews.author: Rebecca Findlater
reviews.snippet:
Dismayed with the after service care of this clinic involving my tooth extraction. Tooth was extracted by the only male dentist who gave so much information that he left me feeling anxious and overwhelmed. Several days later, my face was swollen and I had intense pain. I called surgery and Megan advised me to come in. I was treated for dry socket.  She said someone would contact me to see how I was. No one did and I was still experiencing pain after the follow up.
Repeated phone calls back to the surgery where I requested to talk to Megan again for guidance and reassurance were handled by receptionists who I felt bulldozed over my situation and left me feeling dismissed.  No one has contacted regarding how I feel yet! I was left feeling like a nuisance and still my mouth is as sore as the day it was done!
Please consider when using this dentist as I as left feeling very dismayed.

reviews.author: Stephen Ryan
reviews.snippet: The dentist used a mirror to show me what the issues were instead of just talking about it. Very friendly team across the board and pricing was about what you should expect to pay. Relaxed atmosphere.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.snippet: Went well

reviews.author: Josephine Ainuu
reviews.snippet:
I am so grateful to Dr Chuen Lin Hong. She recently did a composite filling for me and the whole experience was excellent. She walked me through the entire process, explained everything clearly, and made sure I knew what was happening every step of the way.

What I appreciated most was how often she checked in on me during the procedure to make sure I was comfortable and doing okay. It made me feel safe, reassured, and well cared for throughout. I trust her completely and am very happy with the result.

I have also been seeing Kumar Vedagiri for my dental hygiene appointments and have always had positive experiences. Not only are Dr Hong and Kumar wonderful at what they do, but every staff member I have interacted with has been friendly, welcoming, and professional. The whole team creates an environment where you feel comfortable and genuinely cared for. I would highly recommend this practice to anyone looking for quality dental care.

reviews.author: Natalya Gumenyuk
reviews.snippet:
Highly recommended!   On May 25th 2026, I had my very first dental consultation in New Zealand at Knox Dental Ltd (Dunedin), and I am absolutely delighted with my experience.
From the moment I walked in, Amy and Shannon at the reception gave me a very warm welcome. They were incredibly kind and helped me step-by-step with filling out the patient forms, making me feel comfortable right away.
The atmosphere in the clinic is very friendly, which helped me relax—usually, dental exams and X-rays make me quite nervous. Dr. Jacob Grieve is a true professional. He took very clear color photos and high-quality X-rays. During our discussion about implants, Dr. Grieve was highly knowledgeable, responsible, and explained all possible treatment options in great detail. I honestly did not expect such an exceptional level of care and attention.
On top of the fantastic service, their prices are very reasonable. I am very happy to share my experience and highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for great dental care!

reviews.author: Paia Munro
reviews.snippet: I have been coming to this clinic since I was about 13. Lumino is absolutely fantastic. I highly recommend them if you have anxiety. They are very patient and kind.

reviews.author: Oscar Drummond
reviews.snippet: Great team at lakeside dental, I was in town for work and needed to get tooth pain checked out before I flew, they were very knowledgeable and also very friendly probably one of the best dental practices I have been to. 10/10

reviews.author: Caitlin Williams
reviews.snippet: had 2 molars pulled out and Adrian and his wife were so kinda and made me feel so comfortable the whole time.

reviews.author: Bruna Pezza
reviews.snippet:
I was SO nervous about getting my wisdom tooth removed, but they made the whole experience feel calm and safe from start to finish. They were incredibly caring, patient, and constantly checked in to make sure I was okay, which meant everything to me.

The procedure itself was way smoother than I expected, and they explained everything so clearly, which really helped ease my anxiety. You can tell they genuinely care about their patients and go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable.

If you’re scared of the dentist like I am — this is 100% the place to go. Thank you so much for taking such good care of me 💕

reviews.author: Marianne Heyden
reviews.snippet: I was traveling to Queenstown from Chicago ... I had a dental emergency. Dr. Paul was able to see me right away. He treated me and truly changed the rest of my trip ... no more pain! He was very efficient and kind. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Serena Xu
reviews.snippet:
It's been a month since my emergency root canal done by Dr Adrian and I want to sincerely thank him and his lovely wife Claire. ❣️  I was in Queenstown for a company's convention trip and had a terrible toothache on the first night. I walked in to their clinic which was a 5 min walk from the hotel I was staying and Dr Adrian did some x-rays and told me I needed to do an emergency root canal as my tooth cracked and was affecting the nerves and causing me intense pain.  Surprisingly the procedure was painless and I didn't even realised he gave me 2 Injections till I went back the following day to ask him. 😅I was able to attend my company's dinner and was happily eating 2 hours after the root canal that my colleagues can't believed I just did a root canal 🤣

I went back to him 2 days later to complete the root canal procedure and this saved me the trouble of coming back to Singapore to find an orthodontist to explain to him what happened.  Once again Dr Adrian performed the second procedure painlessly and finished in time for me to attend my company's closing dinner.  🤗

I would highly recommend Dr Adrian as his skills are exceptional and price reasonable and most importantly it was painless!  👍👍👍👍👍

Thank you Dr Adrian and Claire for making my holiday to NZ a very pleasant one.  Hope to see you in Singapore or NZ again 🙏

reviews.author: Susan Elbers
reviews.snippet:
Excellent practice. I found this practice when one of the owners was doing emergency work and liked them so much I changed dentist!
Phil is kind & gentle, upfront with all your options, and does a superb job. My front teeth now look better than they have for many years! Totally recommend.

reviews.author: Amy Scott
reviews.snippet:
Epic friendly & professional service.
Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Warren Macnee
reviews.snippet: Just had a root canal and tooth rebuilt. Phil and his assistant did an amazing job, hardly felt any pain. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jennifer F
reviews.snippet: Very good job fixing my broken crown plus they were very kind and understanding of my anxiety.

reviews.author: Ad Keith
reviews.snippet: Very friendly and professional. Best dentist I have been to in years!

reviews.author: Bryce Hunter
reviews.snippet: Always top service very caring dentist

reviews.author: Georgia Richardson
reviews.snippet: I've been to a lot of dentists and Dr Lim is my favorite. The whole practice is great and very kind and thoughtful. Dr Lim is very good with questions and providing you with the information you need especially about preventive care and is gentle and efficient. Had routine appointments and also wisdom tooth extractions and they went great. Also very affordable. I've recommended it for years but have since moved away 😊

reviews.author: Philip Morris
reviews.snippet: Friendly, clear advice

reviews.author: Susan Partel
reviews.snippet: Calmed my nerves and made me feel in safe hands.

reviews.author: Mike Trinder
reviews.snippet: Everything was great, the people also were great.

reviews.author: Lew Butler
reviews.snippet: My child had his wisdom teeth removed last week with IV sedation and everything went amazing.  From the consult through the procedure, everyone was very helpful and kind, provided accurate and helpful information and prepared my child for exactly what would happen.  The fees were very reasonable and actually significantly less than we were expecting.  Overall, an absolutely positive experience and I would highly recommend Otago Oral Surgery

reviews.author: Jacob Gerken
reviews.snippet: Had all 4 of my wisdom teeth removed here yesterday. The team were amazing so comforting and checked in with me the whole way around how I was feeling. Even followed up with me to make sure I was okay. Could not recommend them more thanks for making me feel comfortable and helping to settle all my anxiety!

reviews.author: Carole Morrison
reviews.snippet: A good experience for a large tooth extraction, didn't feel a thing.  However months later I am still experiencing sensitivity, which was expected as roots were exposed alongside the extraction.  One molar beside the gap is very very sensitive to cold and I wonder if it also  needs a  root canal.

reviews.author: Geof Blance
reviews.snippet: Jesslyn and the team were great. Excellent treatment and great post care follow-up. Many thanks

reviews.author: Rob Huntington
reviews.snippet:
Recently I was very nervous with the thought and knowledge that I was soon to be sitting in the dentist chair with Jesslyn to have teeth removed.
This is not anywhere near my top ten places to be.
What I found with Otago oral surgery is ease of parking, comfortable reception and welcoming staff.
My dental surgeon Jesslyn was an absolute professional with a warm nature whom I would recommend to anybody needing dental surgery.

reviews.author: Tavake Manu
reviews.snippet: I hadn't been to the dentist in 10 years, Was intimidating seeing the dentist. But my experience with Bhavya was awesome I would recommend everyone to see he if she's available. Awesome work team.

reviews.author: Sharon Shaw
reviews.snippet: Lumino Pitt street is great...the staff are lovely and Ken is wonderful ...he puts me at ease even though i am fearful of dentists

reviews.author: John Simon
reviews.snippet:
I had my first appointment with Charlotte the hygienist and she was very thorough and caring. Very happy to recommend her services.
Thank you Charlotte 👍

reviews.author: Mike Jack
reviews.snippet: My very expensive filling just fell out.

reviews.author: Jamie Crook
reviews.snippet: John is the most understanding dentist. He also has to deal with my unique health considerations. I am truly grateful for his professionalism and how approachable he is. Couldn't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Brianna Leahy
reviews.snippet: Hannah was amazing to see and hopefully was able to save my half broken off tooth 🤞 it currently looks amazing with the resulting of a significant part of it. I have pretty bad anxiety especially with things around my face and have a low tolerance for LA - it was great having someone so supportive and accomodating looking after me during this dentist visit.

reviews.author: Lisa Armishaw
reviews.snippet: $220 for consultation what a joke! Plus synergy dental keeps ringing my partner every week! Give him a break he's just lost a family member

reviews.author: Martha Vorster
reviews.snippet: The surgery went well and I had NO pain or problems afterwards which was amasing.

reviews.author: Wendy Taylor
reviews.snippet: I recently underwent dental surgery at QTOM Surgery. The team were excellent. From the first appointment through to surgery, the communication was first class. Any questions I had were answered quickly. I was totally relaxed about the dental work to be undertaken. Peter & his team make you feel so at ease. Maddy the receptionist is wonderful, very professional & nothing is too much trouble for her. I can highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alan Papert
reviews.snippet: Excellent painless highly professional. And am patient and an orthodontist. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Lee Exell
reviews.snippet: Excellent support and service. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kerry Lynn
reviews.snippet: The team at QTOMS are excellent, the support from the Auckland and Queenstown clinics was top notch; they juggled calendar bookings to help alleviate tooth pain quickly and the experience all-round was great. Very accommodating, kind, adaptable and of course top level expertise. Much appreciated!

reviews.author: Garth Swan
reviews.snippet: Friendly & professional.

reviews.author: Megan Webster
reviews.snippet:
I have been going to wanaka dental since 2007.  Looks like there has had a new staff change.

They were great,  friendly and professional.   Stephen was amazing. Really professional,  fast & Did a great job. Definitely recommend him to others

reviews.author: Karen Guglietta
reviews.snippet: A very friendly practice.  I felt listened to and recommended procedures were explained fully, with no pressure.

reviews.author: Indi Perera
reviews.snippet: Cheerful staff and professional service in a very friendly way. The team made my daughter feel comfortable and welcomed throughout  the visit.Highly recommended

reviews.author: Neil Marshall
reviews.snippet: Best dentist in Wanaka. There is always space to see a dentists or a hygienist, which is not true for all Wanaka dentists.

reviews.author: Liv Jorunn Gasland
reviews.snippet: Had an appointment with the hygienist today.  She was so gentle, I almost fell asleep.

reviews.author: Simon Bennett
reviews.snippet: Really a very good dentist, much better than any of the ones I went to back in Auckland.

reviews.author: B
reviews.snippet:
Do not go here. The dental assistant was lovely but Larry the dentist was rude and tried to force my jaw closed with his hand on the thing you bite when they are taking an X-ray, I told him it was painful but he insisted it was just uncomfortable! I had to pull has hand away from my face.
When I shook my head to myself in disbelief he told me not to shake my head at him and that he was ‘being positive’ not sure about his logic there! I didn’t appreciate being told off when I am in a vulnerable position and still hadn’t had the dental procedure done.
I would definitely not recommend this person. Only that they were the on call dentist and I didn’t have a choice.

reviews.author: Izzy EJ
reviews.snippet: Really disappointing communication and rudeness from the receptionist. Would never recommend anywhere that treats clients like that. Wouldn't book another appointment if all my teeth fell out.

reviews.author: Christina Roberts
reviews.snippet: Great service, Jenna the hygienist, was an absolute gem

reviews.author: Kathy Harris
reviews.snippet: The staff are friendly and helpful. AA.+

reviews.author: Andrew Maguire
reviews.snippet: Brilliant service, great to deal with, thank you

reviews.author: Megan McLeary
reviews.snippet: Always a quick and painless experience, the whole team are friendly and inviting!

reviews.author: rui huo
reviews.snippet: I had my teeth whitened and repaired. The dentist was very skilled, and the nurse made me feel very relaxed. The whole treatment was easy and pleasant.·

reviews.author: Vaine
reviews.snippet: Andrew Koh is very professional and did a great job on my filling, he is informative and has helped me understand any concerns i have with my teeth and what i must do. I will be coming here again, Cheers.

reviews.author: Todd Stevenson
reviews.snippet: Excellent dentist  highly recommend

reviews.author: mike shepherd
reviews.snippet: Excellent expierence. They where the emergency dentist at the time rang at 11am had an appointment for 4pm that day. The receptionist was great the dentist was great and after expecting to be paying hundred of dollars was pleasantly surprised that it was far far less then I expected good work invercargill city dentist I was impressed

reviews.author: Tia Pikia
reviews.snippet:
I’m really disappointed with the service here. I called today to book an appointment and was told I can no longer make bookings because I missed one appointment nearly a year ago, back in January. Previously, I had a lot of trouble getting through to them. I would call and no one answered or called back, and I eventually had to walk in just to make that appointment.

To be refused care almost a year later over one missed appointment is unreasonable. Healthcare shouldn’t prioritise lost time or money over people’s actual health needs. Based on my experience, I do not recommend this clinic.

reviews.author: Pamela Bernal
reviews.snippet: UK citizen here. Got an appointment for the very next day, and everyone was fantastic and lovely. Job well done 👏 Can't thank them all enough x

reviews.author: daryalann sim
reviews.snippet: Fantastic place i went as I needed emergency dentist appointment and surgery very anxious but they were extremely helpful got through the appointment and the surgery.

reviews.author: Derek Woodgate
reviews.snippet: Amazing. I was quite anxious about going after a few years of not going. Alejandra was fantastic and I can see why they have so many positive reviews.

reviews.author: Anna Cody
reviews.snippet: Highly recommend Emma. She fixed my tooth today and it was a very pleasant experience which I never thought I'd say about visiting the dentist. She is mums dentist and mum also highly recommends Emma. Fantastic work. Everyone there was friendly and inviting   and very appreciated. Thank you so much for saving my tooth.

reviews.author: Steve Wagstaff
reviews.snippet: The dental care that I received at Remarkable Smile Dentistry was excellent.  Manu was professional, friendly and empathetic. She and her assistant are a great team.

reviews.author: Wendy Hansen
reviews.snippet: Efficient friendly team. Very professional.

reviews.author: Margaret Elaine Sadler
reviews.snippet:
Always receive fantastic customer service, with friendly and professional service. I'm only too happy to give Lumino The Dentist in Greymouth 5 stars.  the whole area of the clinic  was clean, comfort,
: Hygienist  was gentle,, explained procedures clearly.
pain-free experience, improved smile.

reviews.author: Justin Matthew
reviews.snippet:
I went in for a routine dental cleaning, which I’ve always done twice a year. After starting, the dentist decided to use anaesthesia and completed only the top teeth, then stopped and said it would take longer than expected and asked me to book another appointment.
At reception, I was told the next available appointment is after 3 months, meaning I’m left with an incomplete cleaning for a long period. This should have been assessed and communicated before starting the procedure.
Overall, poor planning and disappointing experience.

reviews.author: Christian Le Numero Cinque
reviews.snippet:
Being a german tourist traveling NZ and having lost a gold onlay on New Years eve exposing a sensitive tooth I didn't manage to get any hold of a dentist. Interestingly the state health system in NZ is totally unorganized when it comes to dentists. There is no dentist on duty for emergencies even in a busy place like Queenstown...
So I was so happy that Dr. Matthew had a look at my tooth even when I walked in to inquire for an out-of-line appointment for the next 2 days.
Unfortunately they hadn't the right material but their sister praxis around the corner had and they send me there without charges for their check.

5 stars for Matthew and his team.

To continue the story I would give Gary zero.

AS: I rushed there and found out that Gary closed earlier than his biz hours (also not possible in other health systems).
So I went there extra at opening hours 8.30 to enquire for help. No chance. I even left my number and hold myself available for 1,5 days but they never got back to me.
And to make things worse for me
I  lost a piece of the unprotected surface 2 days later as the tooth wasn't be able to care for in the NZ dentist system.
Oh btw I  got a info on one answering machine in Qtown that if I had an emergency they would open the pracis again for a base fee of 350 dollar plus treatment cost... at that point I was still hoping to find a dentist on emergency duty ;)

reviews.author: kiri robertson
reviews.snippet: Best dentist ever!

reviews.author: Ginger G
reviews.snippet: Tony made the best set of dentures I've ever had! They are not only so comfortable with less ulcers but the price of a full set is very affordable compared to the majority of other places. Plus Tony is a great, kind guy.

reviews.author: Brendan Brown
reviews.snippet: A wonderful dentist. An absolute professional who charges a surprisingly reasonable fee considering how fantastic the treatment is. I come from out of town just to see him, that's how good he is.

reviews.author: Declan Richmond
reviews.snippet: So lovely! Central Dental made me feel safe going to the dentist. Lovely staff, great service and amazing treatment options. Thanks for all your help!

reviews.author: Jacqui Gaye
reviews.snippet: Loved this practice but our favourite dentist left.  Very challenging hygiene appointments x2 - too vigorous and in tears both times - lovely lady though just too intense treatment - I had plaque but not crazy.  Told I must floss and 2 weeks later lost half a tooth.  Went immediately down there (early am) but no one interested, re attended at end of day and no understanding of spending a pain filled day and unhappiness at what I consider poor advice to floss on large filling.  More interested in the dollars than my discomfort.  Suggested best I head home for 3 days and wait for an appointment when they could fix tooth properly, as not enough time now although 200.00 could do a temporary fill but advised would be wasting money - better to wait 3 days.  I queried doesnt it need a crown - response - well actually yes.  Left unhappy, confused and in pain. Have booked dentist 991 in bali which is recommended highly by friends who live there and changing local dentist.   Good luck with these guys.

reviews.author: Jason Bates
reviews.snippet: Amazing work, fast, pain free, great staff, fair pricing, definitely recommend central dental,

reviews.author: wendy emson
reviews.snippet: Cannot fault my first experience here and I would feel confident coming back again.

reviews.author: Shane Sapwell
reviews.snippet:
What a great and professional experience, the team are very welcoming and considerate to your needs!!

Highly recommend ⭐️

reviews.author: Paul Sewter
reviews.snippet: Amazing service for a custom dental product delivered in less than 24hr at one third (yes one third!) of the price quoted by other dentists in Dunedin... Very friendly and helpful staff too. Super happy to endorse this dentist!

reviews.author: Nicole Rodgers
reviews.snippet: Had an appt with Esther and it was the best cleaning I have ever had. Thorough while still being fairly gentle. Great explanation will def be back. I don't often do reviews but highly recommend.

reviews.author: Zoe Wood
reviews.snippet: I went here for a hygienist appointment, so professional and informative. Recommend.

reviews.author: Terence and Gail Gardiner
reviews.snippet: A great dentistery from my experience. I needed an urgent extraction during a trip and they were able to look after me at short notice. The dentist was very communicative and the treatment lived up to the 'gentle' name. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Isla Fairchild
reviews.snippet:
I’ve been to Gentle Dental before and had a fantastic experience, so I was a bit disappointed by this checkup. The atmosphere in the room felt uncomfortable, and the treatment was rougher than what I’ve experienced in the past, despite having years of orthodontic and prosthodontic care.

While I don’t have a dental phobia, I would recommend that anyone who does discuss their concerns beforehand to ensure they feel comfortable during the visit.

reviews.author: Lew Butler
reviews.snippet: My child had his wisdom teeth removed last week with IV sedation and everything went amazing.  From the consult through the procedure, everyone was very helpful and kind, provided accurate and helpful information and prepared my child for exactly what would happen.  The fees were very reasonable and actually significantly less than we were expecting.  Overall, an absolutely positive experience and I would highly recommend Otago Oral Surgery

reviews.author: Jacob Gerken

reviews.author: Carole Morrison

reviews.author: Geof Blance
reviews.snippet: Jesslyn and the team were great. Excellent treatment and great post care follow-up. Many thanks

reviews.author: Rob Huntington
reviews.snippet:
Recently I was very nervous with the thought and knowledge that I was soon to be sitting in the dentist chair with Jesslyn to have teeth removed.
This is not anywhere near my top ten places to be.
What I found with Otago oral surgery is ease of parking, comfortable reception and welcoming staff.
My dental surgeon Jesslyn was an absolute professional with a warm nature whom I would recommend to anybody needing dental surgery.

reviews.author: thomas family
reviews.snippet: I really miss Nick, he was a great dentist.  Great to now have a new dentist.  Hope he stays and becomes full time 5 days a week.  Lovely little clinic.  Wonderful staff and facilities

reviews.author: Joy McGee
reviews.snippet: Very friendly & professional treatment.

reviews.author: Daniel McCormack
reviews.snippet: It's so great to finally find a compassionate hygienist and dentist who treat patients with care and dignity. Mildred and Nick were awesome!

reviews.author: Joel Jacob
reviews.snippet:
Amazing team down at Shearer Dental.
Was quite on time with the schedule and had everything sorted out. Had an extraction in hardly 10 minutes and was on my way. 5/5 for service and hospitality. :)

reviews.author: Sarah Dorsett
reviews.snippet: Best Dentist experience yet, Nikki and Libby were amazing, very thorough and great to have the parking on site too. Thank you!

reviews.author: Angela Thompson

reviews.author: Monique
reviews.snippet: Everyone there is the sweetest. I had Nikki as a dentist, and she made me not hate the dentist anymore. So caring and understanding, making sure im comfortable. Feels like people actually love their job there

reviews.author: Neneh Martin
reviews.snippet: For someone who finds the dentist daunting I can not recommend Dental Care Nelson enough! Incredible service and clear communication on what was needed to have my teeth health back on track.

reviews.author: nipuni peiris
reviews.snippet: Amazing work done at dental care Nelson by Dr Andrew!

reviews.author: Marcia Higgs
reviews.snippet:
Outstanding service from lovely lady on the phone who went out of her way to get me in when I rang early with a severe toothache to the fab dentist Bertie and friendly assistant.
Highly recommend
Thank you

reviews.author: kontessa
reviews.snippet: Couldn't be more happier with Andrew and his expertise, I left my appointment educated about my general and future oral hygiene. Highly recommend! Thanks again.

reviews.author: Alina Pavlova
reviews.snippet:
I had my front tooth chipped (looked pretty bad) on Friday afternoon just before a public holiday. Andrew was able to see me last minute and have done an impeccable job on the filling - you wouldn’t even know. Andrew’s is a craftsman!!
He took good care of me as I am also in my 3rd trimester of pregnancy and even gave advice of how to maintain healthy teeth.
Couldn’t recommend Andrew’s family practice more! Lovely team 💚

reviews.author: Bee
reviews.snippet:
I was referred here by my own dentist to see Dr Rishi Pavaskar. The entire appointment, from booking to the visit was very good.

Joseph who booked me was kind and helpful, and Dr Rishi and Delta were great too.
At times like this when you're in pain and feeling anxious, the care you receive makes all the difference.
I would highly recommend Dentist on Kelvin for lovely staff and professional dental care.

reviews.author: rosiedeepsouth
reviews.snippet: Emergency extraction today. I've had several over the years and the extraction today, while still heinous, was a better experience because of the very, very kind staff. Would 100 million percent recommend for chair side manners for starters

reviews.author: mike shepherd
reviews.snippet: Would not recommend at all. Have been with this dentist for years. Rang this morning and after 3 times waiting for 5 minutes at a time finally left a voice message to call me back. Office lady rudely rung me back accusing me of rescheduling an appointment I didnt have. I was calling to try and see a dentist over tooth pain I'd had over the weekend. The rude office lady told me she dosnt know when or if an appointment would be available now or in the future and recommend the emergency dentist. Im very dissapointed in them especially having been there so long and having spent so much money. Whats the point of having people on your books if you can't provide the exact service you advertise. If looking for a dentist I'd hight recommend anywhere else

reviews.author: Marilyn Audenia
reviews.snippet: The only dental pratice in town that accepts my appointment for an emergency toothache! Really appreciate it

reviews.author: Dandan Lu
reviews.snippet: I thought the reception lady was very helpful and professional when I popped in today to get some gel. She was informative and pleasant!

reviews.author: Trina Hanson
reviews.snippet:
We all have to go at some stage.
Maintenance.

Staff are lovely.

Toilets available

Appointments necessary.

Drinking water available.

reviews.author: Brian Mitchell
reviews.snippet: Great service friendly competent staff

reviews.author: Jonathan May

reviews.author: Lorina Harding
reviews.snippet: Albert did an excellent job and was very gentle considering what he had to do! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Richard Robinson
reviews.snippet: Albert and Emma were a great team. They're ensured I had a pain free and successful tooth filling replacement and kept me informed about what was happening throughout the process

She was professional,  caring, efficient and kind. And I was all done in good time.  I'm very grateful.

reviews.author: Cheryl Palatchie

My first experience has been excellent.   I was given a very prompt appointment. Lyn was very kind and did a great job. I was all done in two visits in the same week. Her assistant was lovely and the Receptionist very welcoming.

reviews.author: Barbara Pagel

reviews.author: Ross Hart

Tina is an artist,She listens and has immense patience, Janine is a darling; she is always so prompt in responding to my emails, Also; this is a modern equipped place with efficient microscopes and 3D x-rays available,
If anyone is looking for a smooth and painless root canal treatment,this is the place!

reviews.author: Clint Tauri

reviews.author: Lisa Carnie
reviews.snippet:
Incredible experience!  Would rate Dr Hess a million stars if I could!  Dr Hess has treated myself and my entire family. Before finding him, I was traveling to Dunedin and Christchurch for dental care for my children.  He is an around expert in his field.  He takes great care to help the children feel comfortable in the dental setting, helping them to select a show that they like to watch while he gets the information he needs from his examination.  He takes care to educate us as parents and makes sure we understand the implications of treatment options available and what is necessary.  He is incredibly proactive.  For my care, it honestly felt like walking into a day spa!  Greeted with his friendly team, watching a movie while he did his treatment, and he took great care to explain everything so that I understood.

He has great respect for his team of dental nurses, and hands over to his admin team with care and kindness to make sure the whole experience is exceptional and very trustworthy.  Thanks Hess!

reviews.snippet:

The reception staff were very welcoming and friendly, the waiting area clean and bright, and I was quickly seen by dentist Alex Hearn. He examined then X-rayed me and explained that he could not find anything that necessitated a filling or other procedure but appreciated that we had a very long road trip ahead of us, involving some rural areas in which it might prove difficult to find a dentist should the need arise. He then cleaned around the area of discomfort, painted on sealant and reduced the lower opposing tooth. Alex was extremely reassuring and professional throughout the consultation and said to phone him if I should need stronger pain relief on my travels.
The cost of this consultation plus X-ray was very modest and much less than what would have been charged back home in England!
From my experience, I can wholeheartedly recommend this dental practice and remain grateful for their prompt help and expertise.

My appt was at 9.45. I was not asked to go through until 10.09. It was always made for that day, I was on a waiting list for cancelations but was never contacted. The customer service was appalling.

After having to wait 2 months for the appt with multiple sore tooth & me informing the receptionist that I needed a tooth out, I waited 25 min after the appt start time to be asked to go in. No-one bothered to inform me of a delay or anything.  Once in the appt, the dentist kept asking what area was the most sore, indicating to me he only had time to look at 1 thing despite my prior conversation with the receptionist. After briefly looking in my mouth, his cellphone rang, which was 5 minutes of him organizing a tow truck. In the end he didn't do anything to my teeth except take xrays. I suffer from anxiety at the dentist due to previous dentists. Graham York knew this and was great with me. Unfortunately this hasn't continued with new ownership. If I kept a client waiting 25min with no updates I wouldn't be in business long, but for some reason dentists & doctors can.

It's been such a horrible experience here, and Dr. Bentley is so racist, you couldn't do wisdom teeth surgery with high risk, and refered me to some one else, but also  can not do a proper filling to normal teeth which surprised me a lot, I am so regretted to trust you again, next time your receptionist can tell patient directly in the phone, $350 for a filling is the price to attracks you here,  when you come on the site and tell you that's the minimum price and  no treatment no cleaning the decayed part but sealing it charge you $450, if you want to have a proper filling at least you need come twice and pay the price twice, otherwise the dentist will seal my decayed teeth and let the root get infectious which now is not and let it cause bigger problem, spend more money and blame me it's my own problem because I didn't brush more than 2 times a day.

reviews.author: Louis English
reviews.snippet:
I have been meaning to write a review for Origin for many months, unfortunately life has been a little hectic over the last year.

I have had trouble with my front incisor/first lateral since I damaged it in 1999, over the years there had been many many operations to save the teeth including apicectomy, root canals and failed implants.

In 2024 I was referred to see Soo-Wee who advised me that replacement of my existing implant, bone and gum grafting would be best course of action, the operation was also performed under sedation. This was completed and it has quite literally changed my life.

I cannot thank Soo-Wee and the whole team for their hard work and expertise in rectifying many years of average dentistry, restoring my faith in the profession and above all the care and concern they showed in my obvious dislike of dental procedures.

I hope to never have to have another large scale dentistry in my life, but If I do I know I will be coming back to this practice.
The practice itself is modern, well designed with easy access, they have access to state of the art equipment at the forefront of the industry. The staff are attentive to your requirements and both the pre and post Operation care is flawless.
I can say without a doubt that this is probably one of the best (or in my opinion THE best) oral surgeries throughout the whole of New Zealand.

This clinic has been instrumental in regaining my ability to eat all the food stuffs that had caused me issues in the past, and improved my overall health both mentally and physically.

If this review had the option for 10 stars it would be given. class these 5 as 10!

Thank you Soo-Wee, Lydia, Kate, Chanelle and the whole team at Origin,

All the very best & Kind Regards
Louis English

reviews.author: Victoria Pickett
reviews.snippet:
Went here this time last year and saw Dr Richelle Tan. As it was my first time going to the dentist as an adult, I didn't know what to expect. She was very nice, but I suspect she either doesn't know what she's doing, is very bad at communicating, or is not especially trustworthy. I'll explain why.

She noticed a "hole" in one of my teeth after an examination and x-ray and then another one while cleaning my teeth. I asked if they were cavities (which would need drilling) or fissures (that might need sealing) and after a lot of confusion she said there was decay and tried to get me to get them filled at the appointment. This wasn't good for me so I booked another day (I also wanted to get a second opinion from my dentist friend because I thought it was weird that the second hole wasn't noticed after the x-ray).

Got the two filled by Richelle, but in the meantime I had noticed two other fissures in my teeth so got her to check them out. She said that there was  some decay in both and tried to get me to get them filled at the appointment again (she quoted $150 so this wasn't going to just be a fissure seal). I was not confident in her abilities since she was telling me that I had two new cavities that she didn't find during the dental exam, so explained this to her in an email and got her to send my x-rays to another dentist. She backtracked, and said (after telling me I needed fillings ASAP at the appointment) that I could probably just watch and wait or have preventative maintenance.

Anyway, I just got around to finding another dentist today (East Tamaki Dentist) and she said my teeth are fine and the fissures are just natural. The dentist there said that if I can keep them clean they won't need fillings.

I was also charged $250 for the teeth clean and found out today that East Tamaki Dentist would have charged me about half that.

TL;DR I think the dentist was either trying to convince me that I had cavities when I didn't or genuinely doesn't know how to tell the difference between a fissure and a cavity. Receptionist was lovely though.

reviews.snippet:
I have spent a while choosing Invisalign provider, Cosmetic Dental was one of more expensive options.

Dr Michael Kan is very friendly and professional.

Throughout the year I had my Invisalign I have however experience many issues.
- I was after the advertised Invisalign experience, where I could track and see my progress in the app, on multiple occasions CD staff didn't know how to set me up for the app, or refresh the scans for me so that I can see the updated treatment, I have been told that other clients do not use the app (which I found to be irrelevant). It also took many calls and emails to get anything done.
-Once an attachment was left incorrectly on my tooth for over a month, until I felt something was wrong (I was able to see in the app that there should not have been an attachment). This put an additional delay to the process.
-On at least 2 occasions I was asked to come back the day after the scan to be rescanned, as technicians didn't validate that scans were successful at the time.
- There a time I made an appointment over email and later learn it was never in their system
- I constantly felt like I was receiving conflicting information. In one appointment I would be told I didn't need a wire. On the next appointment - my tooth wouldn't have moved if I had a wire.

A year later, I was so over the clinic experience (not the Invisalign itself) that I agreed for it to be over (which was my call, but there was no recommendation to continue either). Now wearing night retainers daily, one tooth at the bottom still moves forward noticeable every day during the day, as there not enough space, which is just a daily reminder of this experience. Obviously it is a great improvement compared to before. And Dr. Michael Kan did a great job on composite bonding.

I had scan of my teeth done recently, where my dentist noticed an infection at the botom of one of front teeth. Then I asked CD for my pre-Invisalign scans, it was clear that the infection was there before the Invisalign treatment, but this is something that was not flagged or mentioned to me at all! Which my understanding is one of the reasons to do the scans in the first place. (Also they emailed me someone else's dental records first)

**Exercise Caution with This Practice!**

I invested over $2,000 in dental fillings with Dr. Sherry, only to discover that the quality of her work was inadequate and required correction by a different dental provider.
Despite my numerous requests for a referral to another dentist, Dr. Sherry consistently assured me that she could address the issues herself.

Regrettably, my new dentist uncovered that Dr. Sherry had left a substantial amount of decay in one tooth, merely placing a filling over it and charging me for two separate fillings for the same tooth.

I strongly advise having your fillings evaluated by a competent professional to prevent potential complications. My experience was exceedingly disappointing and financially burdensome. I recommend seeking alternative dental care to avoid similar issues.

reviews.author: Tian Tompkins
reviews.snippet:
I’ve only written one other review before, but I felt compelled to share my experience with Dr Richard Longbottom at Noble Dental following my appointment today.

After a past traumatic dental experience, I came in feeling extremely anxious and struggling to trust dentists again. Because of this, I decided to see a periodontist and implant specialist so I could get the best and most accurate advice, even though it meant spending more money. I had read positive reviews about Dr Longbottom and felt he would be the right person to assess my situation.

During the appointment, I became quite emotional, but Dr Longbottom and his dental assistant, Gemma, were incredibly kind, patient, and empathetic. Gemma also shared a personal dental experience which helped me feel less alone, and I really appreciated her warmth and understanding. I genuinely felt listened to and supported, which meant a lot given my past experiences.

What really stood out to me was Dr Longbottom’s honesty and integrity. After reviewing my case, he actually recommended that I don’t get an implant and instead suggested a crown. He could easily have recommended the more expensive option, but he didn’t. That level of honesty really helped rebuild my trust.

He also referred me to a general dentist he personally trusts and even reduced the cost of my appointment, including not charging for part of the X-ray. When I was settling up at the end, Carly at reception was also very kind and reassuring, which added to the overall positive experience.

I’ve lived in Auckland for 6½ years and honestly haven’t ever felt like I was in good hands with a dentist here until now. I walked away feeling heard, supported, and confident that I’m finally on the right path.

I’m very grateful for the kindness, honesty, and professionalism I experienced.

Highly recommend Dr Richard Longbottom at Noble Dental, especially if you’re feeling anxious or unsure about dental treatment.

reviews.author: Sing Duan
reviews.snippet:
As of 16 May 2026, despite the clinic acknowledging that its private response did not match its public commitment, nothing has materially changed.

I chose Stanmore Bay Dental Studio Ltd partly because of its positive Google reviews. Unfortunately, my experience was very different and raises serious concerns about accountability, transparency, and patient protection.

This review is shared so others can make informed decisions before proceeding with major irreversible dental treatment. All statements below are supported by records.

I paid $27,310 for extensive upper and lower bridge treatment involving irreversible preparation of 19 teeth. Both bridges failed shortly after placement. I continue to experience pain, difficulty eating, and significant functional problems. Specialist corrective treatment is now estimated to exceed $70,000.

The most serious concern is that ACC later accepted both bridge failures as treatment injuries. ACC findings stated the outcomes should have been avoidable with appropriate care, including proper material selection and ensuring adequate periodontal health before treatment. As a patient, learning that the failures were considered avoidable and below the expected reasonable standard was extremely distressing.

Despite this:
• Refund requests were refused
• I was advised to pursue the treating dentist personally
• I was informed the clinic had no responsibility because dentists operated as self-employed contractors
• I was told dentists could not be sued in New Zealand

After the clinic owner declined a refund, I filed a claim through the New Zealand Disputes Tribunal. During the legal process, I formed the view that some statements made regarding indemnity insurance, ACC coverage, and financial responsibility were misleading and did not accurately reflect the actual situation. I believe this directly affected the outcome and resulted in only part of the payment being refunded.

Another major concern was the clear difference between the clinic’s public statements and its private conduct.

Timeline of Public Promises vs Private Conduct:
• 17 Nov 2025: The clinic publicly responded to my Google review stating they wanted to resolve the issue and invited contact
• 19 Nov 2025: I responded in good faith
• 08 Dec 2025: My emails were blocked
• 29 Jan 2026: Another public response was posted again inviting communication and acknowledging prior communication issues
• 01 Feb 2026: I responded again in good faith
• Shortly afterwards: Communication was blocked again

Many people rely on public responses when deciding where to seek dental care. My experience suggests that public statements may not always reflect what happens privately once concerns are raised.

It has now been nearly three years since treatment began. I live with ongoing pain, difficulty eating normally, permanent damage to 19 teeth, and major financial and emotional consequences.

I visited this clinic because I had been experiencing significant pain in one of my lower teeth. During the appointment, I mentioned that I thought teeth grinding during sleep might be a possible cause. However, I was disappointed that this assumption seemed to be accepted without further investigation.

No X-rays or additional diagnostic tests were offered, despite me being willing to pay for them. Instead, I was advised to purchase a mouth guard to help with grinding. While that may be a reasonable recommendation if grinding is the confirmed cause, I left feeling that the underlying issue had not been properly assessed.

The pain only started a couple of weeks ago, and I have never previously experienced tooth sensitivity or similar symptoms. I also noticed that dental floss repeatedly frays when used around the affected area, which added to my concern that there could be an issue such as a cavity, rough filling, crack, or another dental problem that may warrant further investigation.

I would have appreciated a more thorough examination before a treatment recommendation was made. Overall, I left feeling frustrated and uncertain about the diagnosis, as I don’t feel enough was done to determine the actual source of the pain

I needed double jaw surgery since I was young to correct a facial asymmetry. Now in my > 30s, working and living in New Zealand, I finally had the means to proceed. However, every orthodontist I consulted in Auckland refused to take my case because my surgeon was based overseas in Korea. After spending a lot of money on consultations, I kept hearing: “We can’t take your case — it’s too risky to work with an overseas surgeon,” even though my surgeon is world-class.

Everything changed when I met Dr Austin Kang at .Ortho. He gladly took my case, bridged the communication gap between two countries, and carefully prepared my teeth exactly as my surgeon required before surgery. He is now guiding my post-operative orthodontic treatment after both my upper and lower jaws were moved forward.

I cannot recommend Dr Austin Kang highly enough. The team at .Ortho are true perfectionists, deeply committed to delivering the highest quality of care. Their dedication, compassion, and attention to detail go far beyond words. Their work has been praised not only by my surgeon, but the results truly speak for themselves.

I’ll soon be uploading a YouTube blog about my double jaw surgery, where I’ll explain how my orthodontist in Auckland (.Ortho) and my clinic in Korea worked together to fix my asymmetry and give me the beautiful, balanced bite and symmetry I always dreamed of.

reviews.snippet: I had not had a dental check up in over a decade so I was quite nervous to see the dentist. However, the staff were all very friendly and nonjudgmental. reviews.author: ThatAutisticBastard
reviews.snippet:
$255 for dental cleaning is not very money worth I would say. Been told if it’s a routine cleaning it would be like $180. Well it’s been 2 years since last time I went to a dental. The cost of living here is insane.

And they told me it’s $230 - $250 during the process then told me it’s $250 after the process then when I checked out it’s $255.

And I didn’t ask why I have to pay $5 more because I have autism I learned not to ask questions.

And then maybe just an expectation thing, they didn’t give me my receipt though I didn’t ask. I just thought I’m supposed to get a receipt if I spent a lot of money you know.

After I got home I started googling, I found there’s a dental at sunnynook has a clear price list and the price is much more reasonable.

My final thoughts
+ Don’t go to big chain who hides their price.
+ Do your research thoroughly.

reviews.author: Marcella Adisurya
reviews.snippet: Very friendly and efficient staff! Really happy with my dental cleaning and checkup :)

reviews.author: Gabrielle McNabb
reviews.snippet: Highly recommend Dr Dana! My hygienist clean was an absolute 10/10 experience, she was friendly and informative, took her time, did the job with precision & I didn’t feel a thing. Will definitely be back in her chair for my recall 😊

reviews.author: A D B
reviews.snippet: Dr. Seema has been great in helping me find the best approach to fix my teeth problems. She knows where to focus and works with my teeth with such gentle hands and friendly tone. My procedures have been intricate but Dr. Seema did them with ease.

reviews.author: tao wang
reviews.snippet:
This is an incredibly heartwarming dental clinic. I came here for an emergency toothache treatment. When Miss Neetu at the front desk saw the terrible state I was in, she immediately stood up to find a doctor. The doctor then took the initiative to speak with the patients who had arrived before me and were waiting, arranging for me to go first so I could receive immediate emergency treatment. At that moment, I was in so much pain that I was seeing stars and shaking all over—thanks to them, they truly saved me! I would like to express my deepest gratitude here! 🙏🙏
​The doctors here are highly skilled, and the pricing is very reasonable. Every single staff member is professional and warm, especially Miss Neetu at the front desk, who is always smiling and genuinely attentive to every waiting patient. Wishing her the best of luck and happiness. Thank you! 🙏🙏

reviews.author: Chandrakala Konar
reviews.snippet: I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Anusha Veerappan during my dental appointment. I went for scaling and was very worried because one of my teeth got chipped during the process, especially since I am pregnant. But she handled everything so calmly and professionally. She smoothly filled the chipped tooth and also treated two other decayed teeth without anesthesia or X-rays, making me feel safe and comfortable throughout the treatment. Her care, patience, and reassurance meant a lot to me. I truly felt I was in good hands. Thank you for the excellent service

reviews.author: Zoe P
reviews.snippet: Excellent dentists! I came to see Dr Lakshay after putting off dental work for too long, and without making me feel judged at all he helped me make a plan for treatment. All the treatment I needed was much more affordable and way less painful than expected! Dr Lakshay and all the dental assistants I’ve seen in my time there are all so professional and kind. On one of my early visits when I was having quite a bit of treatment done and was really nervous, Isabel even loaned me her headphones so I could listen to a podcast on my phone since I’d forgotten mine and really wanted to distract myself - she has a heart of gold! Now I recommend the clinic to anyone who tells me they need to go to the dentist, and I’ll keep coming back all the way from West Auckland, because it’s worth the trip.

reviews.author: Yish Fontanilla
reviews.snippet:
I had a tooth extraction at Sunnynook Dentist today, and I can't recommend them enough! From the moment I walked in, the receptionist was incredibly kind and polite, making me feel welcome right away. My dentist, Zareen, along with her dental nurse, was absolutely fantastic. Before the extraction, Zareen gave me proper advice and clearly explained what I could expect, which really put my mind at ease. She was super attentive during the procedure, making sure I had enough anesthesia and keeping me calm all throughout. Afterward, she thoroughly went over all the post-care instructions, including what to do for healing and when to schedule my follow-up cleaning/check-up. I felt completely prepared for the recovery process.

Overall, I'm genuinely satisfied with their dental service and will definitely be recommending Sunnynook Dentist. Thanks, Zareen and team, for such a smooth and positive experience! 🫡😊🦷

Today I tried call again and same thing. Nobody answer. Reluctantly I had to switch to another dental place, what a shame. Btw I just called 2 alternative placed and at least my calls are getting answered by both dental clinics.

reviews.author: Aly F
reviews.snippet:
I had a great experience with Dr Ali. He is extremely skilled and knowledgeable. He worked on one of my teeth that had previously been declined by several other dentists. I have Trigeminal Neuralgia, and he was mindful of my condition.

Because dental work prices are not regulated, it can be hard to find a dentist/dental practice that cares about their patients and empathises with them and any financial constraints they may face. I feel assured that this practice is fair and the prices are reasonable.

The receptionists are warm and friendly, the reception area is beautiful, and the facilities are clean. Dr Ali played music during the session which felt comforting and less sterile and bleak. As I suffer from a chronic nerve condition that causes extreme pain around my facial area (teeth included), I usually dread dentist appointments, but this appointment was much more easygoing.

Overall, the service was excellent. I highly recommend this practice and Dr Ali (unsure of surname)

I told them it shouldn't be that bad quality as other fillings I have last more than 10 years. They say will call me back, but never did. reviews.author: George Enache
reviews.snippet:
I am very disappointed with the service I received at your clinic.
From the moment I arrived, the experience felt unprofessional. Despite having a booked appointment, I was left waiting for over 30 minutes past my scheduled time.
During the consultation, I felt uncomfortable and disrespected by the dentist. Instead of receiving professional care, I felt judged and mocked regarding my dental implants and the dental work I have had done previously. This was upsetting and inappropriate from Madison Chang.
After reattaching my crown, the dentist did not offer me an opportunity to rinse my mouth or remove any residual cement. I also received no aftercare instructions. In fact, after leaving the clinic, I had to return to ask whether I was able to eat, as no information had been provided.
Overall, the level of care, communication, and professionalism fell far below my expectations. As a result, I will not be returning to your clinic and would not recommend your services to others.
Kind regards,
George E

I highly recommend the clinic and team members, thanks for taking such good care of me in my time of need 🙏

They were much further through the surgery than I thought at the time. Kris was very good at explaining things before and after. The quoted cost was less than I assumed it would be too.

reviews.author: Matthew Harris
reviews.snippet: I have seen Kris as my dentist for 4 years and could not ask or recommend a better person.kris noticed a sore on my lip and got me quickly into maxi facial  and lucky for me i had the cancer removed i had been seeing my doctors  about the sore and they did nothing  a simple dental visit made a huge impact on my life .every visit is done with my best interest and such care every time .as a patient I feel lucky to have Kris and Parkside as my dental team highly recommended if you want a great healthy smile thankyou Parkside dental

reviews.author: Grace Fully
reviews.snippet:
No, i dont recommend them!
They arent there to help the tooth, they are there to cover the problem instead of helping to fix the problem.
Its been almost 6 months now and im still in pain. Sensitive pain!
You didnt put down the sensitive numbing agent over the nerve to help the nerve heal, you just plonked a filling on top!
My last denist was more precise about how to deal with a sensitive tooth.
Now, im going to have to spend another $400 finxing what should have been done in the 1st place.
I spoke to you about the nerve, yet you failed. To put any treatment on. I told you that my tooth needed it and im puzzled as to why not?
More money for you in the future when you think ill have to extract it?? Not impressed Japaneese guy!!

reviews.author: Robynn Alex
reviews.snippet: We are from out of town and had to take our niece for a toothache, that was giving her issues as the dentist in our town was unable to see her  until next week.  The Dentist that worked on her was awesome and very informative.  The owner Taryn,called today, a day after we saw them to follow up and give us some very happy and unexpected news.  Thank you Parkside Dental!  We have been here before for some other work, and have always felt good vibes from this practice, which is why we would travel the 2 hours from where we live to come here!

reviews.author: Melissa Lynton
reviews.snippet: On behalf of my sister Victoria and I we would like to say Zina and her assistant are great. very professional, knowledgeable, full of recommendations that we take heed of.  Recommend A++

reviews.author: Ann Louise Gough
reviews.snippet: Such a warm welcome at reception!  😀 and  Karen the hygenist was amazing, She is very friendly,  thorough, gentle and explained the procedures to me at my first ever visit to the hygenist.

reviews.author: Navjot Kaur
reviews.snippet: My 5-year-old son had a toothache and was very scared of dental procedures. At another clinic, he was unable to go through with the treatment. However, Dr. Amanda made the whole experience much easier for him. She was very calm, patient, and gentle, and she managed to perform the extraction without making him feel too much pressure or anxiety. We are very grateful for her kindness and professionalism. Highly recommended for children!

reviews.author: Zina Abu Ali
reviews.snippet: I recently had a cleaning appointment with Grace and had a really positive experience. She was warm, friendly, and made me feel comfortable. The clean was thorough, but she was very gentle and took the time to explain what she was doing and answer any questions I had. I also came away with some really useful tips for looking after my teeth. The team at Thompson Dental were welcoming and professional, and the clinic has a great atmosphere. I’d happily recommend them to anyone looking for a dental clinic in Mount Eden

reviews.author: Ben Gowan
reviews.snippet: Unreal service and a warm and caring team that truly cares about your health. I could not recommend this place anymore!

reviews.author: ryan larraman
reviews.snippet: Who falls asleep while having multiple teeth filled at the dentist?    Smooth, friendly, painless.  Those daunting dentist visits are endangered with these guys around.  And your cavities?   - gone.  Perfect work. Six stars

reviews.author: Paul Dengate
reviews.snippet: I've been a patient at City Dental for several years now, and the level of care consistently exceeds expectations.  The friendliness of the staff, their professionalism, the quality of the care and after-care, their communication ahead of and after appointments ... all excellent.  Highly recommended.  I wouldn't consider anyone else in Auckland for my dental health care.

reviews.author: graham head
reviews.snippet: Thanks to your excellent team at City Dental Lounge, I now have 2 repaired molars with crowns at the back. No more niggly pain. And the Process was pain free & done in one day (I didn't even feel the numbing injection).  Thanks for sorting me out Dr Harris & Shi, much appreciated.

reviews.author: Ryan Murray
reviews.snippet: Who would have thought getting a filling could be enjoyable? When Dr Bell retired I was dismayed as he was such a skilled and gentle dentist but somehow Francesca is even better! The combination of bite block, dental dam and YouTube video+headphones made it a relaxing and painless experience (was not a small filling either) - I almost forgot I was at the dentist. Thank you

reviews.author: Yu Tony
reviews.snippet: Very grateful, Dr Xavier did an great skillful work my 2 crowns and filling, great thinking design process like an architect drawing up an perfect plan whilst accomdating well calculated adjustments as discoveries was made along the way. The result was no more pain; no exaggeration- to the whole team Charlotte, Rachel, Dr Karen Thankyou all for being very caring, it gave me an  wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Karen Meyer
reviews.snippet:
Dr Ordelheide is gentle in his approach, very thorough, explaining everything he needs to do! Such a pain-free experience!!
Best dentist !!

reviews.author: Melanie Gray
reviews.snippet: Small human had to get a broken tooth pulled and the process was made as smooth and painless as possible, this sort of thing is always a worry with a neurodivergent kiddo but I was super impressed!

reviews.author: Hannah Mare
reviews.snippet: recently visited this dentist for some cosmetic work, and from start to finish, the experience was exceptional. I’ve always been shy about my smile and a little nervous about going to the dentist, but the entire team made me feel completely at ease. They were warm, welcoming, and genuinely caring, taking the time to understand my goals and even helping me work within my budget. The results are amazing far beyond what I imagined and I couldn’t be more grateful. Thanks to their skill and kindness, I feel confident about my smile for the first time in years. Much appreciated 👏

reviews.author: Tom Gregory
reviews.snippet: Our 7 year old got referred here after some issues at another dentist. The staff here are amazing!! Really wish we had come here first.   Would 100 percent recommend this clinc. Thank you!!!!

reviews.author: Dana Maton
reviews.snippet: Sim at Dazzle is an awesome dentist. Really good if you're a bit anxious (like me). Have had quite a bit of work done the last couple of years, old fillings replaced, a root resorption and a couple of crowns. Sim makes you feel at ease, prices are reasonable compared to other dentists, and I don't dread going to the dentist anymore. She even has her own mill, so crowns can be done all in one day. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Petrus Du Toit
reviews.snippet:
I can’t recommend Dazzle Dental enough. I was dealing with immense toothache and had an appointment booked for Saturday, but the pain became unbearable. I reached out, and they genuinely went out of their way to get me in earlier and sort me out.

From the moment I arrived, the team was understanding, professional, and focused on getting me relief as quickly as possible. You can tell they truly care about their patients and not just the appointment schedule.

If you’re in pain or just looking for a dentist that actually goes the extra mile, these are the people to see. Absolute lifesavers.

reviews.author: Kevin Sadgrove
reviews.snippet: Thank you Dr Sim for your great service at just short notice.Amazing work and so caring as is the staff at Dazzle family dentists very appreciated Barbara

reviews.author: Keith McLean
reviews.snippet:
What a wonderful place, modern, clean and comfortable. The staff here are fantastic!!! from the receptionist to the hygienist to the dentist, very professional, polite and accommodating.

They thought I was coming in for a clean, but then realised I hadn't been clear on my online application (I messed that up), as I was in for an overall check-up and assessment/quote.
This was a Saturday morning, so I was expecting to have to do another appointment, but no, the dentist decided to do a full assessment, including X-rays on the spot. She saved me the hassle and was so nice about it. I will definitely be back to have the work done, and would recommend this clinic on that experience alone.
Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Matt and Abbie Watchman
reviews.snippet: Jared is a great dentist. Good to back with him..

reviews.author: Michael Gottschick

In an email sent to me regarding the changeover it was never mentioned that I would need to make a new appointment or indeed that my original appointment was cancelled. Will find an alternative dentist for he future.

reviews.snippet:
Great friendly service. Nicki went 2 a lot of trouble to ensure a great fit & put me at my ease.
