reviews.author: Te Rua Flavell
reviews.snippet:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Outstanding Care from Nicky!

I can’t speak highly enough of my experience with Nicky at the Auckland Denture Clinic in Royal Oak. From the very first appointment she made me feel completely at ease. She explained every step of the process in a clear, friendly, and professional way, so I always knew what was happening and what to expect. That level of care and communication gave me real confidence from day one.

What truly sets Nicky apart is not just her technical skill, but the way she helps restore your confidence and your smile. She understands how personal this journey is, and the care she puts into her work reflects that. When I received my dentures, I was told it would take about a week for my mouth to adjust — but they were made so well that after only two days they already felt natural, like I’d been wearing them for a month. That level of quality is incredible.

Thanks to Nicky, I’m not just happy with the fit — I feel comfortable, confident, and genuinely good about my smile again.

Top-tier service, outstanding workmanship, and a truly supportive experience from start to finish. I’m very grateful and would highly recommend her to anyone considering dentures.

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.snippet:
I am very impressed with the service I received from this practice. My denture was in very bad shape and needed a major remodel. The advice i received from Nicky and the professionalism,  that followed. Just incredible!!.
A huge thanks Nicky,
You have made my year,
Kind Regards,
Richard.

reviews.snippet: Fantastic Dentist .  So helpful and had my tooth extracted.  I did not feel anything in 15mins it was over. He explained his procedure so nicely before and after.  Will recommen him 100% to friends and family. Thank you ❤️

reviews.author: Yogish Gowda
reviews.snippet: No wait, we reached at the exact appointment slot and were promptly seen. The dentist was sensitive and courteous.

reviews.author: Anna Hansen
reviews.snippet:
Hi there I had a root canal done and a separate filling at Switch Dental yesterday with Dr Laura Bridger she was amazing I felt so well taken care of as I suffer from anxiety both Laura and her assistant done a fabulous job !!! If you feel anxious or stressed Laura and her assistant are the people  you need !! So thank you for taking such good care of a nervous patient I really appreciate all that you done for me

reviews.author: Michelle Keedwell
reviews.snippet: Absolutely thrilled I made the move to Switch Dental. After a terrible dental incident several years ago I had been anxious to have further work done. I saw Alex to have a crown replaced after seeing the practice offered a same day crown service. Wonderful experience from start to finish. Nil pain, and a crown that fitted like a glove. Alex, and technician Ruby are both simply amazing. So kind and supportive and absolute experts at what they do. Yesterday I had further work done and I  now have another crown that fits so perfectly I cannot detect it’s not an original perfect tooth! Again, no pain and magnificent work from Alex and Ruby. I cannot praise Alex enough for his skill and approach. After an initial check up I was given options for each area of concern and I did not feel pressured to get work done immediately as I do feel I’ve been railroaded in the past at previous practices. I could make well-informed decisions that worked for my personal wellness and my budget. I have absolute trust in Alex and that means a lot to me. All the staff I’ve encountered at the practice are lovely which makes the overall experience 12/10

reviews.author: Cassidy Porter
reviews.snippet: Angela is so lovely! Very good at what she does and is informative whilst doing so. I learnt a lot as she explained what she was doing, why and how to manage things at home. Would 1000% recommend this dental practice

reviews.author: Derek Evans
reviews.snippet: Very professional and friendly great service

reviews.author: Ruth Whelan
reviews.snippet:
Recently had my wisdom teeth removed and Kelly and the rest of the team made the experience as good as it possibly could have been. If you’re nervous about going to the dentist, you really don’t need to be scared coming here, everyone is so kind, professional, and efficient.

I mainly dealt with Kelly, who was absolutely lovely throughout the whole process. Everything was explained really clearly, I never felt rushed, and they were constantly checking in, giving me breaks when needed, and treating me like a human being rather than just another appointment.

I’ve also interacted with the wider team and they are all equally friendly and professional. The follow-up calls afterwards to check in have also been really appreciated. Couldn’t recommend them more highly.

reviews.author: Le Le
reviews.snippet: I had a great experience here. Dr. Au explained my dental issues clearly. The treatment was gentle and effective. The appointment was well organized with minimal waiting time. I’ll definitely keep coming back. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Honey Sharma
reviews.snippet: Very friendly staff and quick at responding to the patients who need urgent care. The dentist , the Assistant and the receptionist were really nice and supportive. Got the procedure done within few minutes and got relief from the shooting pain which I have been experiencing throughout the night.Highly recommended

reviews.author: Daniel Black
reviews.snippet: Lovely staff from the front desk to the chair, expert service and stress-free care. I've had some poor dental experiences in the past and the folks at Victoria Dental restored my faith! Thanks team 👏

reviews.author: Adam Nazari
reviews.snippet:
Imagine you have a very busy day at work, but you take time off to go to your dentist appt. You drive to the town, find a parking spot, pay for parking, run to the dentist office to arrive on time, but when you get there they just tell you, "oh, noone told you?! we canceled your appointment because we are busy today". And you are like, well, you could have at least called me so I didn't come here all the way to find out about your perfect time management skills in person.

So disappointed, of course I won't go back to this place and of course I won't recommend it to anyone.

In response to the answer below: when I arrived they did not tell me we canceled your booking because I was late. They didn't even call to find out why I was being late a few mins and whether I was still coming. They just said, "oh, we canceled your booking because we are busy today" which to me would have been totally acceptable if they had called me and said that but they didn't.

BTW, I booked under my legal name (Hamed) if you cannot find me.

reviews.author: Tony Farrell
reviews.snippet: Great staff. Go out of their way to keep customers happy 😊

reviews.author: Kevin Blakeman

reviews.author: Brad White
reviews.snippet: After breaking my tooth yesterday while eating some hard food. I was not only in pain but knew being in level 3 it was going to be difficult to get an appt with a Dentist and as it was a Friday I didn’t want to have a broken tooth all weekend. However after a call to Adrian Tan and his team who were friendly and helpful, I was not only able to get an appointment but he was able to see me straight away. The professionalism of Adrian and his team was outstanding and they made me feel comfortable and relaxed and after an hour or so my tooth was not only fixed but he did an AMAZING job that I am grateful for. I would highly recommend Adrian Tan and his team for all aspects of dental work 10/10

reviews.author: Anthonie Croul
reviews.snippet: I've never been upset by Dent1st, but I'm overwhelmingly happy with the outcome of my last visit. Dr Sienna Pat and the assistants (I've forgotten their names, regrettably) were some of the best I've had. They were easy to talk to, walked me through every step, and seemed more than willing to offer breaks and reassurance when I needed it. And Maureen, if I am remembering correctly, is a lovely receptionist!

reviews.author: Priya Kumar
reviews.snippet: Took my mother in law for dental checkup and dentures done. Priya was so helpful. Very reasonable price, super fast and so accurate with the dentures. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Monica Katu
reviews.snippet: After reading the good reviews on the website I recently went to fern dental 2 days ago due to tooth pain and gum infection, no appointment and Priya saw me straight away and had given a prescription for antibiotics, so so grateful for her help otherwise I probably wouldn’t be here especially being a stubborn person😅

reviews.author: Ezra Rowe
reviews.snippet: Very satisfied with the level of care and communication of Glow Dental. Anna explained each step clearly and took her time examining and cleaning my teeth and ensured I was comfortable throughout the process. Highly recommend 👌🏾

reviews.author: Joseph Hinde
reviews.snippet:
As someone who gets quite anxious about dental work, I can't recommend Saman highly enough. She was incredibly empathetic, welcoming, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived.

Throughout the entire procedure, she took the time to explain each step, which really helped put me at ease and reduced my anxiety. If you're anything like me and feel nervous about going to the dentist, I would highly recommend booking with Saman.

Thank you for such a positive experience!

reviews.author: David Kao
reviews.snippet: Dr Linda has been exceptional throughout my experience. If you are a nervous patient seeking a caring and attentive dentist, she is someone I would highly recommend. She takes the time to truly listen to your concerns and tailors the treatment plan to suit your individual needs. I will certainly be recommending her and the clinic to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Sarah Bennett
reviews.snippet:
I'd been putting off getting an implant for a while, so I was a bit apprehensive going in. Genuinely glad I chose Glow Dental.

Dr Linda was straightforward and easy to talk to. She walked me through exactly what was involved, what it would cost, and what to expect at each stage. No vague estimates or surprises later, which matters when you're making that kind of investment.

The procedure itself was well-managed. Minimal pain, which honestly surprised me given how daunting it can sound beforehand. I was kept comfortable throughout and never felt rushed. What I noticed just as much was how the admin side was handled. Appointments were organised, follow-up was prompt, and the team was genuinely very nice to deal with. That kind of coordination is easy to overlook until you've experienced somewhere that gets it wrong.

Overall, a really good experience. If you're based in Auckland and looking for implant work done properly, I'd have no hesitation recommending them.

reviews.author: Karen Craig
reviews.snippet: I have been going to Auckland Perio for over 20 years and I give it top marks on all fronts: state-of-the-art care, extremely skilled doctors and hygienists, friendly and capable staff. In this regard, I refute the review I saw here accusing Deb, the receptionist, of being unfriendly. My experience is the opposite. Every time I walk in Deb is there with a smile, greeting me by name. She has always graciously given me as much time as it takes to manage my appointments, including during the worst hassles caused by the Covid lockdowns, and by email when I was overseas. I note that the reviewer who complained offered only one specific, ie,  an "annoying" tone of voice, and managed to slip in a sideways reference to her age. "Annoying" is about as subjective as you can get, and I don't know what her age has to do with it, except perhaps as a way for the reviewer to feel superior, based on nothing except outdated stereotypes.

reviews.author: Nostalgia
reviews.snippet: Debbie, the receptionist is very unfriendly. Abrupt, and there is always annoyance in her tone. Dont like dealing with her and this review is actually coming from another provider's office. She gives older receptionists a bad name.

I can't recommend Leroy highly enough.

reviews.author: Sarah Crawford
reviews.snippet:
A few days ago I turned up on the doorstep of the Ranolf Dental Surgery in the most HORRENDOUS PAIN I'd ever experienced.  Dr Leroy was finished for the day and heading off to dinner with his family, but as soon as he heard how much I was suffering he instantly welcomed me into his surgery and was able to perform an emergency extraction which was pretty much a pain-free experience.  Dr Leroy is kind and friendly and makes you feel like a part of his family, he's honestly that wonderful.  I'm healing nicely and my healing is being aided by the fact that Dr Leroy has been messaging my family since that day, giving valued advice and showing real concern and caring for my progress.  Thank you so much Dr Leroy, I had a terrible distrust of dentists (due to past experiences) and now I feel I can put those misgivings aside at long last.
I can't recommend Ranolf Dental Surgery and specifically Dr Leroy MORE HIGHLY, and can 100% endorse!

reviews.author: B Hapi
reviews.snippet: I've had several treatments both for myself and my children and ranolf dental. The team there go above and beyond every single time to ensure the maximum comfort and less pain as possible 😄. Thanks team keep it up.

reviews.author: Sheryl Pol

When I tried to confirm this today again on an email due to their miscommunication, Larissa was snappy and rude over email so I just decided to cancel altogether and find a dentist that has staff who have proper communication skills.

reviews.author: Thomas Magnussen
reviews.snippet:
I had a fabulous experience at Dental Boutique Auckland during my veneer consultation today.

From the moment I arrived, Aiyaan and the entire team were warm, welcoming, and incredibly professional. The clinic itself is beautifully designed and easily the most impressive dental clinic I have visited in New Zealand.

The consultation was extremely thorough, with comprehensive imaging and scans completed on-site. The technology they use is by far the most advanced I have seen in any dental practice in NZ, which gave me a lot of confidence in the process.

What I appreciated most was that there was absolutely no pressure. The team took the time to explain multiple treatment options and price points, including several different veneer and bonding solutions, allowing me to make an informed decision based on my goals and budget.

I never felt rushed and genuinely felt that they cared about achieving the outcome I wanted rather than simply selling a treatment. The experience was further enhanced by a patient coordinator who followed up promptly via email after my appointment.

I would highly recommend Dental Boutique Auckland to anyone considering veneers, bonding, or cosmetic dental treatment. An outstanding experience from start to finish.

reviews.author: Armando Faes
reviews.snippet:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

If I could give Victoria Riechelmann more than five stars, I would — without a moment's hesitation.

I first came to Clean Teeth Dental in 2020 with advanced, generalised periodontitis — deep subgingival pockets that earlier treatment, even back home in Switzerland, had never managed to resolve. A few of my teeth had already been given a poor prognosis. Six years later (2026) I still have some of them, and I am still smiling. That, quite simply, is Victoria's doing.

Start with the expertise, because it is real and it is rare. Victoria is a perioscopy specialist — endoscope-assisted subgingival debridement, a minimally invasive alternative to periodontal flap surgery that very few clinicians in New Zealand offer at all. She trained in a specialist periodontal setting under a periodontist and has been doing it since 2010, and you feel every one of those years the moment you are in her chair. She understood from the start what too many overlook: that it is the calculus driving the pockets, and that no amount of air-polishing or biofilm management resolves the problem until that is properly and completely removed.

What followed was a staged protocol executed beautifully — initial therapy under local with a supporting course of antibiotics, a proper three-month healing window, careful re-probing and re-evaluation, then perioscopy-assisted debridement to close the deep pockets, with enamel matrix derivative placed on selected sites to give the tissue every chance, and a disciplined three-monthly maintenance programme ever since. She charted, she measured, she explained the prognosis of each tooth honestly — poor, guarded, good — and never once overpromised or upsold. That kind of clinical integrity is priceless.

And then there is the gentleness. My very first deep scaling — hours of meticulous work — was completely painless. No painkillers, not even a difficult evening afterwards. Over six years and many appointments, that has never changed. She is the gentlest clinician I have ever known.

There is also this: Victoria is the Director who runs the practice and sets the standard the rest of the team works to — a command of periodontology that rivals many dentists, paired with the judgement to lead the entire clinical pathway. I live in Hawke's Bay, she is in Auckland, and she has managed my whole journey across that distance — flexible appointments around flights, even arranging my interim maintenance closer to home between visits. Through COVID, through everything, she kept it all on track, and made every visit feel less like a dental appointment than being genuinely cared for — VIP, right down to the coffee.

Victoria — thank you. For my teeth, for your patience, for six years of exceptional care, and for the warmth that comes with all of it. You are a legend, and you deserve every word of this.

And to anyone with a tricky periodontal problem who wants it in the safest, kindest, most expert hands — this is where you go. Victoria Riechelmann is simply the best.

— Armando

reviews.author: Rouru-Koco Lomu
reviews.snippet:
** WISDOM TOOTH EXTRACTION REVIEW **
If you are looking for a dentist who doesn't beat around the bush, very knowledgeable, offers you the best possible treatment for your situation, Dr Kamal Pannu is the person to see. I went to her in absolute agony, I needed a wisdom tooth extraction! I went in so nervous and anxious but after my first consultation, I felt safe in her confidence. She didn't rush into the extraction. She let me go away with antibiotics and time to think about what I wanted to do. However, with the peace of her professionalism and advice, I was sure I wanted her to be the one to do my extraction. On surgery day, they did an xray and used local anaesthetic for a painless removal. She talked me through the whole process which took 15-20mins. Wisdom tooth extraction is not for the weak. I'm so glad she used her 'old school' practises and methods, because the thought of drilling and cutting had me worried. She will tell you what is the best effective method for your recovery sake. After the tooth was out, I was at complete relief. She doesn't use fancy medical jargon to leave you confused, she uses relatable analogies so that you understand.. that was a huge plus for me.

I am writing this review 5 hours post surgery. I have very minimal pain and swelling. Afterpay is available. I highly recommend Dr Pannu for your wisdom tooth extraction, I think I have found my new family dentist.
Many thanks you and your lovely receptionist!

reviews.author: Lee-Ann Kalaha

Highly recommend Dr Kamal 100%!!!
Finally got around to sorting my teeth, should've done it sooner.
Booking was easy peasy, Usha sorts that out for you, a tentative and confirmation text.
Xray taken of my teeth and the treatment options available. By the end of the appointment I opted for complete extraction and immediate dentures.
Using her digital scanner Dr Kamal was able to build a 3D image for my dentures.
After confirmation from the lab to proceed it was about 10 days before I was able to book for multiple extractions, top and bottom.
I could feel the injections to numb my mouth, Dr Kamal was gentle in her method. I could not feel a thing when she took my teeth out.
It took Dr Kamal what seemed no time to perform the extractions, 21 teeth in total.
I was kept at the sugery until she was happy to release me (around 2 hours).
I was very very happy with the look and feel of my new teeth. Griffin DentalWorld Papatoetoe make denture and partial plates onsite. The immediate dentures fit well, better than I expected.
Dr Kamal requested 2 further follow ups 2 days apart. On the second follow up she adjusted the dentures ever so slightly for an even comfier fit.
Dr Kamal oozes experience and makes you feel so comfortable that you forget you are even at the dentist!!!
Great conversation and atmosphere at this surgery.
Regarding cost.......affordable, compared to the last place I got a quote from...it was way cheaper.
5 star rating from me 😁

reviews.snippet:
I wish I could give this place zero stars.

This dentist is terrible. Please avoid going here.

I first went in because I had broken a tooth. They took X-rays, examined the tooth, and told me I needed a root canal. I agreed to the treatment, and we scheduled the start of the procedure for the following week. I also paid the full amount upfront, which was around $1,400.

When I returned the next week, the dentist simply looked at my tooth and told me to come back later.

I came back again, and once again he only looked at my tooth and told me to return another time. The same thing happened repeatedly over the next six months. Every appointment was the same: a quick look at my tooth and another request to come back later.

I became frustrated because I was wasting my time, fuel, and money driving back and forth for appointments where no treatment was being done. I finally told them that they either needed to start the root canal or give me a refund.

The dentist stormed out, and the receptionist came in with paperwork showing the refund amount. I was told the money would be returned within five business days.

That was three months ago.

Since then, I have called multiple times asking where my refund is. Every time I get the same excuses: “I’ll talk to the accountant,” “I’ll check with the accountant and get back to you,” or “I’ll call you tomorrow.”

I still have not received my refund.

Avoid this place, or at the very least do not pay in full until your treatment has actually been completed.

AVOID THIS PLACE.

Later in the appointment she obviously asked if I vape of smoke to update my profile I told her yes I did vape and that lead to an almost scolding about cancer - I told her I was aware of the risks that come with it and i know its a bad habit but she continued anyways, I told her that cancer is a very sensitive topic for me at that time as my mother is battling it and if we could leave the topic behind, you’d think she’d leave the subject but no, she said “see then you know what it does” I don’t think that’s the right thing to say to a person that’s clearly struggling with the fact her mother has cancer. She continued to also sprinkle in more cancer comments throughout the appointment. I understand that making your patients aware of the harms that come with things like vaping/smoking but when you’re told to stop, you stop.
I’m very disappointed with this specific interaction and I hope that she can improve.

reviews.author: Ursela Beasley
reviews.snippet:
Response to the Owner’s Comment

Your statement that this matter was “resolved amicably” is incorrect. The refund was only released after legal intervention and a final demand from my lawyer. The dentures remain clinically and cosmetically incorrect, I have incurred legal costs, and I am restarting the entire process with another provider. These are not “follow‑up treatments.” Formal complaints with the HDC and DCNZ are still underway.

Original Post

18 months of failed dentures, no refund, legal action and formal complaints underway — now having to get dentures made elsewhere.
I attended appointments at both the Hamilton and Cambridge rooms, as all denture appointments were carried out solely by Nikunj Thakor, the owner and only Clinical Dental Technician in the business. In September 2024, I paid $3,500 for new dentures.
Crucially, I later confirmed with my friend that the final physical dentures did not match the wax try ins we had both signed off on. The finished dentures had teeth angled into my bottom lip and were all that was visible when I spoke — a defect not present in the signed off version. They were also not functional for eating or chewing, which affected daily use from the outset. I relied on professional advice that the issues would settle, but this did not occur. It became clear over time the dentures were fundamentally incorrect.
As an experienced denture wearer, it became clear over time that the failure of these dentures was both clinical and cosmetic and attributable to workmanship.
Between November 2025 and February 2026, I attended nine appointments and went through seven 3D try in versions, all with serious defects, including incorrect tooth positioning, cosmetic flaws, lumps under the plate, and short flanges.
At my 13 February 2026 appointment, when I asked to take the Version 7 3D try in home for a second opinion from family, I was told that Version 8 would need to be produced and that I would not be allowed to take Version 8 home as I had with some of the earlier versions. I explained that I wanted to avoid another set of dentures being made that were not correct and that ten minutes in the clinic was not enough time to make an informed decision. I was then told that because of this request, treatment would not proceed and a full refund would be issued.
The promised refund was never issued. My lawyer has issued a final demand, and formal complaints are being lodged with the Health and Disability Commissioner (HDC) and the Dental Council of New Zealand (DCNZ).
I am now out of pocket a total of $4,075 (the original dentures and legal costs), and I am having to fund replacement dentures elsewhere for a further $3,700.
Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this business — the dentures were clinically and cosmetically incorrect, the issues remained unresolved, the promised replacement dentures were never provided, and the promised refund was not honoured.
Total out of pocket costs to date: $7,775.00, plus 18 months of daily physical discomfort and social embarrassment — including withdrawing from social interaction because of the appearance of the dentures and comments from others, with six of those months spent producing seven failed 3D try in versions. I am now having to restart the entire process with a new denture company and Clinical Dental Technician.

reviews.snippet:
I recently accompanied my elderly Dad to Lake Panorama Dental to have his three remaining lower teeth extracted, and I can honestly say the experience exceeded every expectation. They came highly recommended to us by a trusted and mutual friend from DentureTech Hobsonville, and now I can clearly see why.

From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by Loy, the incredibly efficient and well-organised clinic manager. Loy made us feel genuinely valued, cared for, and important from the very start. His friendliness, professionalism, and sincere warmth immediately put us at ease. The kindness and banter we shared meant a lot to both my Dad and I.

The clinic itself was immaculate—spotlessly clean, tidy, beautifully presented, and highly professional. From the outside it may look like a residential home, but once inside, it is a first-class dental clinic that reflects excellence in every detail.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Lisa Fernandes—Dental Surgeon, whose skill, experience, and calm, caring manner were so evident throughout the visit. She is clearly exceptional at what she does. Dr. Lisa Fernandes treated my Dad with such gentleness, dignity, and compassion, which gave us complete confidence and peace of mind during what could have been a stressful procedure.

We also want to acknowledge Amelia, the dental assistant for her support, care and kindness. Every member of the team contributed to an atmosphere of care, professionalism, and genuine compassion.

It is easy to understand why Lake Panorama Dental receives such glowing five-star reviews. Their commitment to excellence shines through in every interaction, and they serve their community with heart, integrity, and genuine care.

Thank you, Loy, Dr. Lisa Fernandes, Amelia, and the whole team. We truly appreciate the important work you do for our local community. Keep shining brightly and making such a positive difference in the lives of others. Highly recommended.💖💞✨💫🙏🏻🙌🏻

reviews.author: a3mmy
reviews.snippet:
I can confidently say that this was the most prompt and seamless tooth yanking of my life.

I visited the emergency room last night for an aching jaw that didn't improve over the last several days. The attending Urgent Care practitioner advised for me to get immediate dental advice to determine the root (lol) cause.

So I did. I booked an 8:15am appointment at 7:52am and drove right there. Dr. Faraj quickly identified the source of the pain as a wisdom tooth impaction, where it also caused a particularly large ulcer. After some local numbing agents were administered and set in, the tooth extraction took place. I closed my eyes because it's pretty spooky, but it was all done in like 45 seconds max.

It's 5pm right now and I literally feel no pain, like I'm poking and prodding my cheek right now and it's completely chill.

Many thanks and big ups to Macleans Dentist for providing such a convenient and pain-free experience.

After she played with my mouth She said they didn't have the Tools to do my extractions and I needed more money and said she put in fillings instead. She told me to come back when I need the teeth pulled where she put my fillings and she couldn't pull because she didn't have the "tools". I told her I paid her the money for the extractions not fillings and she said she used the money on the filling material so I will have to pay again for extractions. I'm currently working with a lawyer because she had put fillings in where I needed my teeth extracted. I went back to her and said I needed a written letter stating why she only did the fillings and I used financial assistance from the government. She said that i had to tell them myself. The law centre in mangere have agreed to help with Me removing my teeth while we work on this case on Dental Planet Mangere with the recordings and evidence I have gathered. Absolutely in so much pain. If you don't have the Tools maybe you shouldn't be operating. And I'm pretty sure it's illegal use the money for work I hadn't been quoted for.  Such a rip off. Do NOT come here! they just want to scam you, they do not care about your teeth!

reviews.author: G W
reviews.snippet:
I've waited almost 3 years before writing this review, but it's important.
in August 2022, I saw a young women dentist (Judy possibly?). I grind/clench my teeth and this dentist made the comment "If money were no object, I'd recommend crowning all your teeth". At a guess I'd estimate this would cost $15,000-20,000. I'm fairly young, I've never had any symptoms from my teeth grinding & I wear a bite guard every night to protect my teeth. 2 years later, I got a 2nd opinion from a dentist in Newmarket, and she was appalled with this recommendation & said that crowning all my teeth would be close to medical malpractice. Crowning all of my teeth would have set me up for a life time of financially crippling dental treatment, because crowns require periodic replacement. Also crowned living teeth have a 33% of needing a root canal treatment within 10 years!

My 2nd negative experience at this clinic occurred in June 2023. I saw a middle aged Asian male dentist (50-60 years old perhaps). The dentist noticed 2 areas of arrested/static tooth decay (non-cavitated & limited only to the enamel). This is a type of tooth decay that is not active/progressing. He recommended getting both cavities drilled & filled. He gave me ZERO advice or education on how to brush this area properly to prevent decay.
I went home and educated myself online, and carefully improved/dialed-in my brushing technique. 2 years later and the arrested decay in these 2 areas has NOT progressed at all. in-fact one of the areas has gotten smaller & remineralised.
It's unacceptable he jumped straight to unnecessary invasive procedures.
also, my new dentist in Newmarket confirmed that these 2 areas of arrested decay didn't need to be drilled and filled.

It's experiences like these, that explain why many people don't trust dentists.

my advice to patients who go to this clinic, is to consider getting a 2nd opinion from a different clinic, if the dentists here recommend invasive procedures.

In addition to his wealth of experience and technical knowledge, John also has the latest technology for capturing images of the teeth as part of his treatment planning process.  One of our sons had hoped to have Invisalign. John detailed the phases of treatment required if that path was chosen as well as the phases required for traditional braces. He recommended, given our son’s dental challenge, the braces route.  Based on the clear explanation and comparative treatment plan, expected results, and the timeline detailed, our teenage son made the decision to go with braces.

John genuinely cares about his patients and their results. He doesn’t rush into treatment, preferring to wait until adult teeth all come through to ensure treatment is completed in the most time and cost efficient way. His clinic  is modern, clean, and runs efficiently, which makes every appointment stress free. Donna on reception is always a ray of sunshine and listens to your needs when appointment planning, particularly with multiple children.

It’s now such a joy to capture photographs of our sons as they confidently smile, happy to show off their perfect teeth.

If you’re looking for an orthodontist who is professional, friendly, and truly exceptional at what they do, I highly recommend John Shennan and his North Shore Orthodontics practice.

reviews.author: Stephanie Brooke
reviews.snippet:
I was drawn in by the positive reviews and a deal on GrabOne, but my visit to Mr. Sachin Sood for porcelain veneers turned into a nightmare. From the outset, the experience was unprofessional and distressing.

When I arrived, I learned the GrabOne deal I purchased (which advertised two veneers for a certain price) was supposedly an error—it was meant to be for one veneer. The dentist wasn’t even aware of the offer until my appointment. Once he realized the mistake, he stormed out of the room, yelling at the assistant to fix it. This behavior was humiliating and uncomfortable to witness. Despite agreeing to honor the deal (legally, he had no choice), it was clear he resented doing so, and his attitude only worsened.

The treatment itself felt rushed and impersonal. I wasn’t consulted about what I wanted, and he didn’t give me the opportunity to ask questions or voice my concerns. He skipped explaining the process entirely, went straight to work, and seemed dismissive of my input. When administering the injections, he was rough and careless, causing immediate and abnormal swelling in my lips. It felt as though he was taking his frustrations out on me, which made the pain unbearable.

I have a medical condition called vasovagal syncope, which can cause fainting in response to pain or distress. Midway through, I told him I was feeling faint and needed a break, only to be snapped at: “Look! You either want this or you don’t. Make up your mind right now!” His tone left me on the verge of tears, but I pushed through. Thankfully, my partner was there to witness the ordeal, but even he was asked to leave when he tried to explain my condition.

The results were devastating. I walked out with poorly done veneers that eventually fell off, leaving me with shaved, discolored teeth and a large gap. When I approached Mr. Sood about fixing his work, he demanded full payment on top of what I had already paid. I had to seek legal advice and go through a lengthy process to get my money back.

If you're considering cosmetic dental work like veneers or crowns, do not go here. Mr. Sood lacks professionalism, empathy, and the skill required for such procedures. His bedside manner is appalling, and he seems more focused on money than patient care.

My advice: do thorough research. Ask for before-and-after photos, read reviews, and check credentials. Sometimes it’s worth saving a bit more to go to a true specialist—doing so could save you from a lot of heartache and expense.

reviews.snippet:
This has been the worst experience I’ve ever had with any dental professional. I went to this clinic for a partial denture after being told by John Kim, the technician and owner to first book a cleaning with their in-house dentist. The cleaning was a complete joke, rushed, careless, and unfinished. Please see attached photo. The dentist even admitted she’d “complete it next time.”

When I called the John Kim to express my concern, he assured me it would be handled. At my next visit, where I have to drive for at least an hour, instead of resolving the issue, I was informed that neither he nor the dentist wished to treat me anymore. What followed was an infuriating exchange where he lied repeatedly, contradicted himself, and finally followed me to the car and  offered a hollow apology, saying he “had a lot on his mind.” When a staff member came out to see what is going on, John Kim introduced him as being the general manager. Upon enquiring further, I discovered this was a total lie.
In my opinion, the real reason for all of this became obvious when I questioned him about the type of teeth he intended to use for the denture. The moment he realised I knew what I was talking about, his attitude changed. It was clear to me that he had misquoted me and was preparing to provide something of lower quality at a higher price, and when caught out, he simply chose to cut ties rather than own up.
This clinic is a perfect example of arrogance masquerading as professionalism. I left feeling deceived, insulted, and appalled by the lack of ethics. If you value honesty, respect, and integrity, do yourself a favour and stay far away from this place. I will be seeking legal advice.

The cleaning itself was extremely painful. My cheeks were held apart forcefully using a cheek retractor tool, and a spray cleaning device was used in a way that felt aggressive and distressing. My gums and mouth continued bleeding for several days afterward, which has never happened to me following previous dental cleans.

This was a very upsetting experience, and I left feeling shaken rather than cared for.

I hope the clinic reviews patient communication and treatment approach to ensure patients receive professional and considerate care.

An ambulance transported me to the Emergency Department, where I remained for 18 hours due to very low blood pressure and extreme pain. The nurse kindly called to follow up and said she would leave a note for the doctor, but I never received any personal follow-up.

For five days, I have needed continuous pain medication, have been unable to properly open my jaw, and have experienced significant swelling and bruising.

This experience left me feeling deeply traumatized. Professional care does not end when the procedure is over follow-up matters just as much.

reviews.snippet:
Our son had a 9.00 am appointment.
To cap one of two teeth.
From the start the dentist was totally unprofessional.
He was administering laser treatment.
Our son jumped in pain.
The dentist enquired why.
Why...because our son could ACTUALLY FEEL IT!
Oh I forgot the pain relief injection!
REALLY?
The dentist then administered the injection.
ONCE AGAIN our son jumped in pain!
Oh...he..the so called professional dentist... forgot the numbing cream
Who is this dentist?
At 11.30 am the dentist advised our son.
He would make up the cap and our son should return at 2.00pm for a half hour installment appointment.
I delivered our son promptly at 1.45 pm to Central Dental for his half hour appointment.
And waited outside.
At 4.00pm I rang the dentist to enquire where the hell our son was.
I was told by receptionist...
I will call you back.
REALLY...
Our son emerged at 4.15pm.
Over 2hrs LATER.
WITHOUT any pain relief or follow up information.
Totally unprofessional and lacking any kind of empathy toward patient wellbeing.
NEVER GOING BACK

Went back again and Dr Christina may be learning. Pretty good manners all up.

Another dentist came in and very rapidly finished up Dr Christina's extraction after what felt like excessive anaesthetic in the mouth vs in the gum, and half an hour of tugging.

reviews.author: cora xiong
reviews.snippet:
We started treatment for my daughter’s crossbite at this clinic around two years ago. She had a baby tooth extracted and wore a plate for about a year. However, last year we discovered she had impacted teeth, and unfortunately the ongoing delays in appointments significantly affected her treatment timeline.

After each visit, the next appointment was usually scheduled 2–3 months later. It took more than six months from the initial discovery of the impacted teeth to finally receiving a treatment plan. After the 3D scan, the surgeon recommended surgery within 3 months, but the orthodontist did not provide the treatment plan until after that timeframe had already passed.

We also had questions about the proposed treatment, but the earliest consultation for answers was another 2 months away. Every long wait meant further delay to my daughter’s care. Sadly, her impacted teeth have now already damaged the roots of nearby teeth, and we are left with no option but extraction.

In the end, we decided not to continue treatment at this clinic. I hope the clinic can improve appointment availability for existing patients and show greater urgency and care when children’s dental health is involved.

My experience with Ross Anning and his team at Auckland City Orthodontics was fantastic, and my only regret was that I didn't do it sooner.

This was my second time with braces; my first was back in my teenage years which was half a lifetime ago now. So much has changed since then and this time, Auckland City Orthodontics made the whole process smooth, reassuring and actually completely pain free.

At the very beginning, they took the time to explain all possible treatment options (and costs) so I could make a decision that was right for me. I chose braces over Invisalign, and I'm glad I did - it wasn't so scary having braces as an adult. Every visit was relaxed, enjoyable and included great feedback about my progress what what would happen next.

Over six months after having my braces off, I couldn't be happier with my smile, and it was worth every cent. It's made a huge difference, and I never thought my teeth could possibly fit together so well. If you're an adult considering orthodontic treatment and feeling unsure, I'd thoroughly recommend visiting Auckland City Orthodontics.

reviews.author: David Lyon
reviews.snippet: Based on my experiences over the last few months, I can’t speak highly enough of Dr Cole. After several oral maxillofacial surgeons had refused my case owing to the risks involved, Dr Cole was the only dental surgeon I was able to locate (in Auckland) who was willing and competent enough to operate. He provided me with 2 generous (late evening) phone consultations prior to surgery, to ensure he understood all key details, and that we were on the same page. This was very impressive and reassuring. On the day of my surgery, he was very welcoming and congenial, with a genuine and caring nature. I have been exposed to more than enough dental surgery over the years to recognise that his surgical skills are superb and thoroughly outstanding. He managed the extraction of my troublesome ceramic implant with great care and expertise, and he was most meticulous with all the surgical steps. As a result, I had zero bleeding post-surgery and did not require any pain relief meds that afternoon or night. I owe a very high debt of gratitude to Dr Cole and would always turn to him first, for any future dental surgery.

During the procedure I found myself clinched my fist because of the pain that was being infected to me. I'm a guy who take pride of a nice smile, I have a good dental hygiene. I hope I could remember the name of this guy, but I was so confused that I bearly remember anything he said.

If you’re posting a review or warning, I’d make it clearer and more professional:

Be cautious when dealing with this dental clinic.

They attract customers with a competitive quote after the initial X-rays and assessment. However, once treatment has started, additional charges of $300 to $500 suddenly appear, often with the implication that the work cannot be completed properly unless you pay more. Or they will suggest to be left with temporary filling, or pay the extra costs.

Then offering afterpay, does not change the fact that patients may feel pressured into paying unexpected fees after treatment has already begun.

Transparency is essential in healthcare. Patients should receive a clear treatment plan and full cost breakdown before any work starts. This experience felt misleading and unprofessional.

reviews.snippet:
Okay, where do start? I hadn't seen a dentist in almost seven years due to a very negative experience I had with a previous dental practice. During those seven years, I would often book appointments with different dental practices and then cancel at the last minute because of the anxiety and trauma associated with that experience.

When I started my new job in December 2025, several colleagues highly recommended Three Kings Dental as I was already enrolled at the local doctors. They encouraged me to at least book a consultation, being local and all, and see how it went.

From the moment I walked in, William at reception was incredibly welcoming. He immediately put me at ease and reassured me that it was completely normal to feel anxious about dental appointments. He spoke highly of Dr Patel and dental assistant Jenny, letting me know they would take great care of me.

Today, I had treatment with Dr Jiang, and all I can say is wow. You know you're in good hands when you don't even feel the numbing injections going in! Not once, but multiple times. Her professionalism, skill, and gentle approach made the entire experience so much easier than I ever imagined.

Over the past three months, I have been extremely satisfied with the dental work completed. The team at Three Kings Dental has not only helped restore my teeth but also rebuilt my confidence and trust in visiting the dentist again.

If you're looking for a dental practice that genuinely cares about its patients, provides high-quality treatment, and understands how to support those with dental anxiety, I cannot recommend Three Kings Dental enough. While the cost may not suit everyone's budget, the quality of care, professionalism, and compassion you receive make it worth every cent.

Thank you to the entire team for helping me overcome a fear that I carried for many years. I look forward to coming through for future appointments.

Dr Hisham.

Major work just completed; not a moment of pain, sure discomfort but no pain.

No one should go through what we went through in the 60s, 70s, 80s, 90s...........

If you have gum disease do not spend $1000s of dollars and YEARS! (yes years) trying to get the bacteria under control.
Laser is definitely the way forward and beats the heck out of scraping, appointment after appointment.

Has your Dr. cared enough to see you out the front door with a freshly made smoothie?

Maybe the abcesses killed me and this was a dream..........
(if it is a dream I can tell you we still work when we are dead because I have to go there now.)

Trust me, you have found your new professional for your oral care.

I visited the clinic yesterday to replace a filling on a lower back molar.
The dental work itself seems well done — there was no pain before or after, and I appreciate that. Thank you for that. I’ll see how the filling holds up over time.

However, I need to raise a serious concern about the anaesthesia.

Shortly after the first injection, within seconds, I experienced an intense reaction — shaking, a racing heartbeat, and a feeling that something was very wrong. It was strong enough that I had to sit up immediately. I was told that the injection may have entered a blood vessel and that the adrenaline caused this reaction. It did pass after maybe 5 minutes, but it was a very distressing experience and has left me feeling anxious about future dental visits.

I have had extensive dental treatment in the past (including extractions, crowns, and veneers), and I have never experienced anything like this before.

After that, the anaesthesia did not work properly on the tooth, and I still had sensation. A second injection was given without adrenaline. I did mention that I preferred a smaller amount, especially after the reaction.

However, the result was that I experienced very extensive numbness — for more than 6 hours, affecting a large area from around the eye down to the neck. This felt excessive for a simple filling, especially as the procedure did not involve root canal treatment or extraction.

In my previous experiences, anaesthesia is usually administered gradually, with additional small amounts if needed, to ensure comfort without prolonged numbness.

Thank you again for the dental work itself, but I hope this feedback helps improve the overall patient experience.

reviews.author: Tina Manuel
reviews.snippet:
Highly recommend John Bridgman and his team of nurses. From our first consultation through to surgery and recovery, the care and professionalism were exceptional.
We traveled from Gisborne for treatment for my 17 year old daughter to extract 4 wisdom teeth under sedation, we were naturally concerned about both the procedure and the journey home. However, everything exceeded our expectations. The ride home was far easier than anticipated, and despite concerns, my daughter remained comfortable throughout with no complications. Recovery has been exceptional. My daughter experienced no significant pain, no bruising, minimal puffiness, and no complications. Stopped pain medication by day 5, has slept comfortably throughout, and never needed to use the stronger back up pain relief. Her only complaint has not being able to eat her favourite foods for a little while.
I would like to note that we hired the hilotherm machine and we were unable to use due to difficulties fitting the supplied mask, however my daughter has experienced a comfortable recovery despite not being able to take advantage of the hilotherm machine.
Thank you, John Bridgman and your wonderful team, for making what can feel like a daunting experience so much easier. We are incredibly grateful for your outstanding care and would not hesitate to recommend your service to others.

One moment I was nearly in a meltdown, the next moment I woke up in a nice cozy chair with a blanket over me and a nurse with a warm smile doting over me , caring for me and making sure my every need was met. Should out to the people on front desk too who were so so friendly and sweet.  10/10!!!

reviews.author: Felicity
reviews.snippet:
Stay away from this place. This practice is no longer the practice it once was under the new owners. Extremely underhanded!

I was a patient here for a few years and always appreciated the friendly, caring, and experienced team. During that time, I felt genuinely valued and had complete confidence in the people looking after my dental care. Not any longer! Since the change of ownership, however, the atmosphere, professionalism, and overall patient experience appear to have changed dramatically. Many of the familiar faces have left, which as a long-term patient I found very concerning.

What shocked me most was arriving for an appointment expecting to see the dentist I had trusted for many years, Dr Paola Fenton, only to discover that I had been booked with another dentist without my knowledge. At no stage was I contacted beforehand, informed of the change, or given the opportunity to decide whether I wanted to continue my treatment with someone else. I found this incredibly unprofessional, disrespectful, and completely unacceptable.

When I asked what had happened to Dr Fenton, I felt I was not given a clear or honest explanation, despite it appearing that staff were fully aware of the circumstances. Looking back, I had already started to question things when an appointment was cancelled several months earlier and I was told she was unwell. The lack of transparency left me feeling that important information was being deliberately withheld from patients.

As a patient, honesty and communication matter. If you have built a relationship with a dentist over many years, you deserve to be informed when they leave. Instead, I was left with the impression that keeping appointment books full was more important than allowing patients to make informed decisions about their own care. It’s all about the money clearly rather than caring for the well being of the patients.

I was equally disappointed by the attitude of the front desk staff. The warmth, professionalism, and genuine care that once existed seemed to have disappeared. My concerns were brushed aside, and I was made to feel like just another booking rather than a valued patient.

What upset me the most was not that changes had occurred, but the way they were handled. Patients should never be the last to know about decisions that directly affect their healthcare. They should be treated with honesty, respect, and given the freedom to choose who provides their treatment.

I have since found that Dr Paola Fenton is now working at Clive Square Dental and will be continuing my treatment with her there. Despite asking questions, I was left to discover this for myself. The fact that patients were not informed and given the opportunity to make their own decisions speaks volumes. It left me with the impression that retaining patients was a higher priority than treating them with the honesty and respect they deserve.

Since my experience, I have spoken with other people that used to see Paola and were treated the same way. The fact that this happened repeatedly suggests a deliberate lack of transparency rather than an isolated oversight. Patients deserve honesty, respect, and the ability to make informed choices about their care.The way this situation was handled left me questioning what other important matters may not be communicated openly to patients.

reviews.author: Jake Harvey
reviews.snippet:
Disappointing experience overall, largely due to communication and administration issues rather than the clinical care itself.

I initially attended for a consultation regarding a filling replacement and paid for that consult, with treatment booked for a later date. When I arrived for the follow-up appointment, I was only then told my original dentist had left the practice and I could no longer be seen by them. As I was in significant pain at the time, I proceeded with another dentist rather than leaving without answers.

The new dentist provided a completely different diagnosis and advised I now required a root canal instead, which was a substantial increase in cost. I was then charged for a second consultation despite the appointment change resulting from the practice’s staffing situation rather than any request from me for a second opinion.

On top of this, the practice repeatedly contacted me advising the consult was unpaid despite already holding and previously using my health insurance details successfully. I had to repeatedly explain that the charges should be processed through insurance, and at no stage was it clearly communicated if something was not covered.

I understand different dentists can have different opinions, and I appreciate the new dentist needed to make their own assessment. However, the overall communication, administration, and handling of the situation left a poor impression.

reviews.author: Courtney H
reviews.snippet:
I had my three children booked in for an appointment today and had arranged for my mum to come over to help me get them there.

I did notice that I had missed a call from an unknown number yesterday, but I didn’t know it was the practice calling. I have checked my phone and did not receive a voicemail. Even if a voicemail had been left, many people don’t routinely check their voicemail messages. I also have three very young children, so I’m not always able to answer my phone immediately and don’t spend my day monitoring missed calls and voicemails.

When I answered a call from the receptionist today, just one hour before our appointment, she immediately rudely made it clear that she had called yesterday and had not received confirmation. I explained that I had seen a missed call from a number but had not received a voicemail, so I was unaware it was the practice trying to contact me. Rather than simply moving on, she repeatedly and rudely insisted that she had left a voicemail and that I had not provided confirmation.

I was genuinely shocked by how disrespectful and confrontational the conversation felt over something so minor. The tone was completely unnecessary and left me feeling uncomfortable enough that I cancelled the appointment altogether. I have no desire to attend a practice where patients are spoken to in such a hostile manner.

What makes this even more frustrating is that I received a text reminder four days earlier which stated that I only needed to contact the practice if I could not attend. If confirmation is required, perhaps the practice should implement a simple reply “YES” system via text rather than having reception staff chase confirmations by phone. It clearly seems to be a source of frustration and unfortunately that frustration was taken out on me.

The receptionist would benefit from some training in how to communicate with patients respectfully and professionally. A simple, courteous conversation would have avoided this entire situation. Judging by the other reviews, this is consistent behaviour from her.

Despite the appointment being booked in person three weeks earlier with the same receptionist, she told me I would need to find another clinic at my own expense. She was very unhelpful in trying to find an alternative appointment. Only after I asked to speak with a manager or requested an email address to formally express my concerns did she suddenly “find” an available appointment for my daughter, which she had previously claimed was impossible for at least a week.

When I arrived for that appointment, she then told me it was scheduled for a different day. After I again asked for her supervisor’s contact details, she said a dentist was available to see my daughter at the originally booked time.

She also refused to give me her name, and she was not wearing a name tag, making it impossible to identify her for a formal complaint.

I would like to highlight that the dentist was very professional, kind, and approachable, and I have no complaints about the dental care itself. However, the receptionist’s behaviour was unacceptable. Because of this experience, we will not be returning.

I also requested the manager’s email address to make a formal complaint, but I was given an incorrect website that does not open, leaving me unable to contact her superior. I sincerely hope this review is seen and appropriate action is taken.

reviews.snippet: This dentist practice has changed my perception of dental care. I have always been a very anxious dental patient, verging on phobic, and would put off check ups and cleans. It was a very affordable appointment and I’m very grateful for the kindness and care I received from the waiting room, to my dentist and her assistant. I would highly recommend The Dentists, especially for those seeking a gentle approach.

reviews.author: Lynda Carlton
reviews.snippet: I've been a patient with The Dentists for many years and found them very pleasant and patient focused. They seem to have all the latest gizmos I enjoyed watching as parts of my damaged teeth are manufactured from almost nothing by computer guided gadgetry... absolutely fascinating. They have married my replacement or rebuilt teeth to look identical to those which have failed...usually from the old amalgam filling damage installed during my childhood. My yearly visit to their lovely Hygienist gets me a visual inspection by her as she searches and cleans through every nook and cranny, then she gets my fave Dentist Tony to  inspect them before giving me an immediate assessment of their status. Sometimes he'll spot something that might cause a bit of grief down the line offering multiple options including estimated costs on how we (him, his staff, and me)can remedy the issue. This round table discussion eases the stress I immediately felt and soon, at a time of my choosing, job done and dusted. But dentists are so expensive I hear you say, The Dentists, and Tony, in particular, have always found courses of treatment that fit within my budget and follow ups can be had to allay any of my  fears that may arise. As a single income pensioner I can thoroughly recommend the whole team at The Dentists, for a caring, empathetic, and very professional approach for anyone having dental issues and wondering who to choose from the plethora of names and businesses available. Ultimately all I can say is I have never ever had any cause or tinge of regret for my choice of The Dentists  over the decade or two I have been with them.

The work was excellent and didn’t hurt the wallet compared to some of the other clinics.
They made me feel very comfortable and have certainly set a new standard for me in dental care.

reviews.author: Jennifer Mabin
reviews.snippet:
The receptionist is good at her job and wears many rings on her fingers.
I lost faith in this particular turangi dentist as he wasnt able to work off another dentist xrays taken 10 days prior. I realised he is only an ai operator and that he was in secure in his own knowledge of dentistry. I was made to feel a nuisance to question his abilities and scoffed at because I requested a lead apron for more xrays his machines needed as to diagnose. I asked staff to come in and hold my hand during the xray and she refused.  How safe is that xray machine if she couldnt join a terrified patient. ?  My xray came out shaky so he proceeded to do a maximised quote to winz of $1000.00 dental care of one extraction and 1 filling.. he completely ripped the government off and my chance of dentistry this year. My extraction was a very loose tooth that id been dealing with pre xmas and only needed his tools and expertiese to pull it out....instead he injected me with god knows what twice (a big fear these days) and did pull tooth out but didnt fill the tooth that was in location of these injectables and booked me a month later.
I had also received another quote via emergency dentist visit in Taupo. Their quote was just over 1000.00 by 200 but covered extraction , scale and clean and 3 fillings.. much more reasonable but unfortunately i missed the appointment through hopeful thinking.  I was attending on line the 12 jan a friends funeral service.. which i had thought i could drive into taupo for 4oclock appointment listening to last bit on the drive in.  A phone call interupted me in the service ...i answered and it was a taupo number saying we have got an appointment on the 15th.. i was wrapped and slowed myself down.to watch rest of service...feeling relieved i didnt have to drive into Taupo from Turangi.
How ever wishfull thinking that it was the Dentists Taupo had called me became a huge oh no moment.  They then charged me $375.00 via the government fund for missing that appointment that i genuinely missed...i have to tell you spec savers was whom phoned me with a changed appointment for 15th jan 26...same day my car was booked for work..needed my glasses that day obviously to see the number that called.
My review on these two dentists are that they have attitudes that see a chance of guaranteed money to a beneficiary so rip the government off which then in turn hinders the chance of us people that need their expertise being able to get treatment.  All about greed. I felt it as a dark energy.

reviews.snippet:
James is a highly qualified and fabulous dentist, I'm so glad I found him after moving to the Waikato from Auckland.

Not only is he one of NZ's forensic dentists with an entire wall covered in qualifications, James is genuinely such a nice person as well. I experience a bit of anxiety which he saw the first time I visited, he remembers this and every time he manages to put me at ease.

James explains what's coming as he works and there is always a bit of playful banter while waiting for the numbing to happen. He uses a numbing ointment first to make the needle less traumatic, and injects it slowly to ensure comfort. He truely is gentle - had my first root canal recently and I didn't experience ANY pain as the numbing wore off which really surprised me.

There's a TV on the roof, and he also offers IV sedation which made having my wisdom teeth out a breeze.

James is kind and respectful toward his staff, with many still with him 15 years from my first visit which speaks volumes. The ladies at reception are warm and friendly, and greet me by name. As a client I feel valued and cared for every time I walk through those doors.

Well worthy of a class A recommendation, if you need a dentist this is hands down NZ's finest. Thank you so much to Jamrs and the team at Gentle Dental Cambridge!

I used to suffer from bad anxiety attacks during previous dental treatments in other places but such anxiety attacks didn't happen while being treated by Dr Hasan Adheem. I truly appreciate his skills and personality in handling anxiety-ridden patients like me.

I’ve just completed my fourth and final session of a root canal at Gentle Dental Cambridge, and I genuinely couldn’t be happier with the experience.

My dentist, Hasan Adheem, was outstanding. He was kind, thorough, and made the entire process feel easy and manageable. As someone who’s naturally a bit nervous about dental work, I really appreciated how calm and reassuring he was throughout.

Cost and dental anxiety were my main concerns going in, but the whole experience was a breeze. Payment with Southern Cross Health Insurance was straightforward, and the treatment itself was mostly painless. Hasan also took the time to explain what he was doing and educate me along the way, which I found incredibly reassuring and appreciated.

The only minor downside is that AMEX isn’t accepted, but that aside, the care and service were excellent. I would absolutely return to Gentle Dental again and would recommend them, especially to anyone who’s feeling anxious about dental treatment.

Went in to make an appointment for dentures. Got told it will be $175 for exam and xray..went in for the appointment, they gave me an exam and got given some options on my budget and told of approx cost of dentures at $7000. Got charged $200 for the appointment with no xray on the way out the door..next day received another quote for $12500 and a totally different plan to what was agreed upon and way above my budget, so wasted my $200 going to them with no recourse. I am sure that they would want another $200  to talk to them again about the plan which was discussed. A very shady dentistry with alot of hidden costs.. avoid if possible. So in all that, I got told a $175 appointment turned out to cost $200 and then told that I was lucky because it normally costs $300 and a $7000 quote turned into a $12500 quote which could rise. I should've realised what they are like by being the only dentist in Hamilton that doesn't have a price guide on their website. I wonder why dentists aren't trusted and people dont like going to them...

reviews.snippet:
Just prior to xmas i had a tooth become loose...as it is silly time of the year i wasnt able to get into any dentist. I nursed that tooth and so wished i had the tool to remove it. On 2nd Jan i had to make call to an emergency dentist. I was seen by a very efficient staff whom had great customer and chair skills. I was sent away with a quote and opted to book in an appointment.  But first available one was the 12th jan which seemed so far away and yet i didnt want to cancel ...the drive in and out from Turangi was hidious with traffic control monstors and i already was worrying about how my week budget was going to get me into Taupo twice as had my car scheduled in for work the 15th. I tried to change my appointment to the 15th.. and receptionist wasnt able to accomodate by calling a patient that may of liked to have bought their appointment forward etc.. i also tried to do the same thing with making an appointment at Spec Savers so at least i was using my budgeted petrol wisely to Taupo. On the 12th i was online to a friends funeral and had planned to drive into taupo listening to the last of it as my dental appointment was at 4 oclock.  I received a ph call during the service and was  so pleased as the message was that there was an appointment on the 15th.  I was wrapped exhaled and slowed down and continued to watch the service . The phone went again and it was the Taupo dentist asking where i was.? Oh my i had had the wishful thinking that it was the dentist that had called with rescheduled appointment. This business dentist then kept 375.00 off my winz quote for that miss..i can understand a consultation charge but found that very greedy amount and told them so.
Their quote for my dental treatment was far more kinder than the Turangi Dentist. The winz annual client treatment only exceeded the limit by $195.00.
1 extraction 3 cavities filled scale and clean.. fabulously fair until the  accidental miss of appointment certainly the evidence i needed is new glasses.  The turangi dentist quote only did 1 extraction and one cavity for the whole winz 1000.00 grant.. i refused the cavity work so ive noted that when it comes to a beneficiary needing treatment some businesses take advantage of the guarreenteed  money...nothing about the person who is needing the care nor the low income that the repayments come out of.
Anyway i just needed my tooth out mostly and so far thats been done with $875.00 of the grant used.. just incredible.

Avoid this place at all costs.

I had a lot of pain, and so I did what was advised by two of their dentists. They pulled a tooth they said was the problem, but the original pain never went away. I then had to deal with the original pain plus they botched the tooth extraction and punctured into my sinus.

I was then put on seven separate courses of antibiotics by Kim to deal with the open hole between my mouth and nasal cavity and was still in intense pain. After three months, Kim sent me to a specialist friend of hers in town for the root canal ( they aren't skilled enough to do root canals) I should have got on the back tooth months before. This was the actual problem and I was instantly pain free.

I eventually went to another Kapiti dentist for a check up, who does it all, and they were incredibly alarmed at how this place really screwed me over with their malpractice.
$5k+ down and a missing healthy tooth, all because of the arrogance of the dentists here.

Avoid this place at all costs.

reviews.author: H Collins
reviews.snippet: Came in to have my two lower impacted wisdom teeth removed, one infected. Instead the dentist removed the upper and lower wisdom teeth on one side. The lower infected tooth was only partially removed leading to not only me spitting up pieces of my shattered wisdom tooth for over an hour but also having to have further surgery at a different dentist around a month later for a root left in because the dentist said he couldn't get to it and it would be fine. The lower root he left in with reassurance that no further infection would persist ended up migrating towards my nerves and jawbone, to the point that both dentists I saw after excruciating pain in the 2 weeks following questioned his practices and recorded what had happened. ACC immediately covered the infected root removal at a different dentist in wellington and in response to my complaints of abnormal post dental surgery side affects Newtown Dental told me the best they could do was refund half of what I paid for the wrong tooth (the cheapest as it didn't need to be removed in the first place) to be removed, as (in their words) "it still costs money to sanitize instruments for the surgery". My mother went to the Newtown Dental a day or so after I did and said she'd never go back because the same dentist I saw was so rough. All the other staff seemed lovely especially the tall brown man who was very reassuring throughout the whole ordeal.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.snippet: After visiting several dentists in Wellington including Lumino and Gentle Dentle who advised that my wisdom tooth was too difficult to remove and required a specialist referral, I contacted Newtown Dental while in significant pain. They were able to fit me into an emergency appointment over the weekend, and Dr. Ray successfully removed the tooth during the same visit without sedation. The procedure was quick, smooth, and affordable. The team was professional, caring, and responsive, and their 7-day availability is a huge bonus. I highly recommend Dr. Ray and the team at Newtown Dental.

I had a terrible experience with Grace Dental and would not recommend their services. I initially went in for a consultation, X-ray, and polishing, which cost $800 — fine, no issue. I specifically told the dentist I wanted a tooth extraction for a broken tooth, and I was assured this would be done on the next visit.

When I returned, they delayed the extraction because they didn’t have the right instruments. I was understanding at that point and agreed to have fillings done instead, which cost another $650. On my third visit, when I was expecting the extraction, the dentist tried to delay it again. By this point, I was in severe pain, frustrated, and decided to leave.

I called Wong’s Dental on Renall Street and was able to get an appointment that same afternoon. They removed my tooth for $350 — quick and straightforward, no delays. Wong’s Dental also had to fix the poor-quality fillings from Grace Dental, costing me an additional $1,000. Now, my bite is much better, and I no longer have sharp edges on my teeth.

I wasted so much money and time at Grace Dental. Because of this experience, my partner and family have also switched to Wong’s Dental. I will never go back to Grace Dental and strongly suggest others look elsewhere for quality care.

I called today to book an appointment and was advised that the next available slot is in two weeks’ time, with no option to be contacted should a cancellation arise. That is frustrating, disappointing, and frankly unacceptable for an enrolled practice.

It raises a serious question about priorities. Significant money has clearly been spent on renovations and fees have increased accordingly, yet access to actual medical care has not improved. Renovated facilities mean very little if patients still cannot see a doctor when they need one. Without adequate staffing to meet demand, the value of enrolment becomes highly questionable.

Ru Ibrahim pretends to be caring, patient , gentle etc.... but any patient who dares to question her methods or diagnosis for treatment will see the nasty, impatient, bossy and over-bearing side of her Jekyll & Hyde personality, that lurks beneath the surface of that 'painted' smile 😬

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.snippet:
I had a mixed experience at Raumati Dental centre First, I want to acknowledge the dental assistant, who was lovely, patient, and compassionate during my visit. Unfortunately, my experience with the dentist was not as positive. I have a significant fear of needles, and during my appointment, I felt rushed and pressured when the dentist insisted that I needed numbing for a filling I’ve had done without numbing before. Despite explaining that I was comfortable managing my own pain tolerance, my request to proceed without it was denied.

The dentist became impatient, mentioning we were 'not getting anywhere' and that other patients were waiting, which only heightened my anxiety and led to a breakdown. I do recognize and apologize for becoming emotional; however, feeling rushed and dismissed made it difficult for me to process. Additionally, I was told I’d have to pay $1,000 for an option to be put under without local anesthesia. Later, another dentist completed the procedure for me without numbing, and I experienced no discomfort.

I am grateful for the support and kindness of the dental assistant, but the overall experience with the dentist left me feeling pressured and unheard.

reviews.author: Tharusha Pillay
reviews.snippet:
I had a frustrating experience dealing with Capital Dental’s Terrace management team.

I got a bite splint earlier this year and shortly after wearing it, I experienced bleeding and discomfort in my front teeth, which I had never had before. When I raised this, instead of being heard and supported, the whole process became unnecessarily difficult.

At first, I was told that the splint had been made using a year-old scan because I had 'requested' it, which isn’t true. I had asked for the same type of appliance as before, how it’s made is a clinical decision for the dentist. Later on, that explanation changed to say the clinician decided reusing the old scan was appropriate, which didn’t sit right with me.

What made it worse was how the complaint was handled. Without examining my teeth, there were suggestions that my symptoms was due to gingivitis, which felt dismissive given the timing. I also tried multiple times to organise an independent review, gave clear availability, and explained that I wasn’t comfortable going back to the original clinician. Despite that, I kept being directed back to the same person or given appointment options that didn’t work, and at one point was told to coordinate between different branches myself.

Despite paying $500 for a splint I now can’t use, there was no real effort to meet me halfway or resolve the matter effectively.

This experience left me with little confidence in how they handle patient concerns. Based on this, I wouldn’t feel comfortable returning or recommending them.

reviews.author: Sonique Paewai
reviews.snippet:
I recently had a wisdom tooth removed by Dr. Byron Park and wanted to share how positive the experience was.

From the moment I arrived, the assistant greeted me warmly, which immediately helped me feel more at ease. Dr. Park checked in to see if I was feeling nervous and took the time to listen to the questions I had prepared. I really appreciated how he explained what he was doing as he went and answered things clearly without making me feel rushed.

What stood out most was how he balanced being efficient and focused on the procedure while still being calm, personable, and reassuring. When I asked to see a photo for clarity, he adapted easily, which made me feel listened to and involved in the process.

The extraction itself was very quick and smooth, and I felt well looked after the entire time.

I’m very grateful for how I was treated and would confidently recommend Dr. Park to others😊

reviews.snippet: Excellent - having neglected my teeth for too many years I took the plunge and made appointments with Suresh who was upfront with what needed to be done but gave options that made sense. Very happy with quality of work done and will try to do my part from here on and take more care and make more visits to both hygienist and dentist.

reviews.author: Hamish Stuart
reviews.snippet:
The quality of care and skill from Suresh and Wendy that I've experienced over the years has been, functionally and actually, life-changing.

They've done exceptional restoration of some really-not-great work from previous dentists - as well as guidance and explanation to make sure I understand what's going on, and what I can do about it.

I've completely come around to Suresh's call of "the mouth is the gateway to health" - and had the (almost) pleasure of one of the smoothest, quickest possible extractions of a wisdom tooth.
